jobs.title: Global Operations Project Manager
jobs.description:
About IWG

IWG is the world’s largest provider of flexible workspace, with more than 5,000 locations
across 120 + countries
. We bring together leading brands such as Regus, Spaces, HQ and Signature, as well as digital marketplace platforms such as Instant Offices, Easy Offices and Coworker. For over 35 years, we’ve enabled organisations of every size—from start-ups and scale-ups to 83% of the Fortune 500—to work more productively, flexibly and sustainably.

Our purpose is simple: help everyone have a great day at work—while protecting people and the planet. We offer carbon-neutral workplaces worldwide and are moving towards achieving Net Zero emissions.

In 2025, IWG delivered record system‑wide revenue of $4.5B
driven by rapid expansion of our capital‑light partnership model. This will continue in 2026 where we will have a target of over 1500 new centre deals as we accelerate towards our long term ambition of 30,000 centres world-wide.

Join us- www.iwgplc.com

Job Purpose

The Project Manager is accountable for the clear definition, structured delivery, and controlled execution of projects from initiation through to deployment.

This role requires the ability to frame complex initiatives, establish robust governance, and manage delivery across multiple workstreams while maintaining strong stakeholder alignment. Successful candidates will be qualified practitioners with the ability to frame projects clearly, manage delivery through defined lifecycle stages, and operate confidently within formal governance structures.

Key Responsibilities

Develop end-to-end operational roadmaps, manage timelines, and track milestones aligned with corporate governance frameworks
Establish operational metrics and report on productivity, cost, and service quality
Lead internal transitions, facilitate stakeholder communication, and train staff on new operational systems or policies

Required Qualifications, Experience, Behaviours

Education: Operations Management, Project Management, or a related field. PMP (Project Management Professional), PRINCE2, or Lean Six Sigma certification preferred
Proficiency in project portfolio tools (e.g., MS Project, Asana, Jira) and data analysis/dashboard software.
Strong cross-functional leadership, advanced analytical thinking, transparent communication, and high emotional intelligence
Consistently delivered results, above expectations
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence in a matrix environment
Confident decisionmaker who demonstrates sound judgement
Organised, consistently delivers against tight deadlines
Collaborative team player and a commitment to excellence
Analytical mindset with the ability to solve problems and improve processes. Comfortable working in a fast‑paced environment
Resilient, able to deal with ambiguity

What We Can Do For You

You are reading the right advert if you are looking for:

A fun, challenging, and rewarding career.
Award-winning induction training and excellent ongoing learning and development.
Fantastic career progression opportunities.
Access to a comprehensive selection of flexible, personalised workplace benefits that support your mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

Recruitment process

Our recruitment process is transparent and objective, because we care about your experience with us. We will respond to you within a few days to let you know if you are moving to the interview stage. This usually starts with a 30 minute conversation with our Global Recruitment Team, giving you the chance to learn more about us and the job. If we both feel there’s a good fit and connection, you will progress through one or two further stages, depending on the level of the position. IWG is proud to be recognised as a Leading Employer,
every year since 2022.

jobs.title: Hub Build Project Manager (Open to Remote, US & Canada)
jobs.description:
Cargill is a family company committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. We sit at the heart of the supply chain, partnering with producers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living. By providing customers with life’s essentials, we enable businesses to grow, communities to prosper, and consumers to live well.

This position is in our Ag & Trading enterprise, where we connect producers and users of grains and oilseeds around the globe through origination, trading, processing, and distribution. We also offer a range of farmer services and risk management solutions.

Job Purpose and Impact

The Hub Build Project Manager will coordinate and supervise all project management activities (Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Safety, Project Controls) of all low to medium complexity build projects in several locations in Ag & Trading NA. In this role, you will coach and work closely with a team of 5-7 site-based Build Project Supervisors. You will ensure that Cargill Project Management systems & tools in your locations are being introduced and consistently executed.

** Remote work opportunity within North America.**

Key Accountabilities

Provide strategic vision to the project team utilizing extensive knowledge of build project management practices and ensures best practices are incorporated into project delivery to champion safety, meet regulatory requirements and deliver build projects with excellence.
Execute low to medium complexity projects utilizing the project management framework to achieve project objectives.
Measure and monitor project progress and key metrics to mitigate risk and increase project performance.
Implement project management best practices based on extensive knowledge.
Apply the right tools and techniques to proactively control project outcomes to deliver a successful project.
Partner with business stakeholders to ensure the business value and technical benefits are enabled.
Coordinate the operational aspects of assigned projects.
Lead and develop a team, coach and make decisions related to talent management, hiring, performance, and disciplinary actions.
Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience
Minimum of four years of related work experience
Ability to travel up to 30% in North America
Must be legally entitled to work for Cargill in United States or Canada

Preferred Qualifications

Project management experience
Safety and quality management experience
Project controls and tracking experience
Construction management experience
Two years of supervisory experience

Equal Opportunity Employer, including Disability/Vet.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Stormwater Engineer
jobs.description:
Location(s): Southern California

Practice/Department: Engineering

Work Environment: Hybrid

Compensation: $150,000-$190,000 annually*

Who You Are

As an employee-owner
, you embrace accountability, working safely, and collaboration while thinking resourcefully and independently.
Like all Dudekians, you are curious and solution-oriented
, with the ability to adapt quickly to changes and approach challenges with a spirit of innovation
.
How You’ll Make an Impact

As a Senior Project Manager (Water Resources/Stormwater)
, you will serve as a senior-level project manager and technical leader responsible for delivering complex water resources, stormwater, and surface water engineering projects. In this role, you will lead multidisciplinary teams, provide technical oversight, and drive innovative solutions that support successful project outcomes for a diverse range of clients.
You will be recognized as a subject matter expert in areas such as hydrology, hydraulics, floodplain analysis, stormwater systems, and watershed management. From project pursuit through delivery, you will apply advanced technical expertise to manage high-impact projects while ensuring quality, regulatory compliance, and client satisfaction.
This position also plays a key role in strengthening client relationships, supporting business development efforts, generating revenue opportunities, mentoring staff, and contributing to the strategic growth of the practice. The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader who is passionate about technical excellence, team development, and delivering meaningful solutions that positively impact communities and the environment.

Duties and Responsibilities

Advanced Engineering and Technical Expertise

Leads technically complex hydrologic and hydraulic analyses, modeling efforts, and engineering studies across all project phases.
Develops, reviews, and approves engineering designs, calculations, drainage studies, floodplain analyses, grading plans, storm drain systems, and stormwater management solutions.
Oversees preparation of technical reports, feasibility studies, engineering analyses, construction documents, specifications, and construction-phase support activities.
Serves as a subject matter expert in stormwater management, watershed planning, flood risk reduction, drainage infrastructure, BMP implementation, and regulatory compliance.
Utilizes advanced engineering tools and software including ArcGIS, HEC-RAS, HEC-HMS, FLO-2D, AutoCAD/Civil 3D, SWMM, and related platforms.

Project and Task Management

Leads multidisciplinary water resources and stormwater projects, ensuring alignment with scope, budget, schedule, profitability, and client expectations.
Manages project financial performance, resource allocation, risk management, and project execution strategies.
Coordinates technical teams across multiple disciplines to deliver integrated engineering solutions.
Provides senior review and technical oversight for project deliverables and critical project decisions.
Ensures projects are delivered efficiently while maintaining quality and client satisfaction.

Regulatory Compliance and Quality Assurance

Ensures compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, engineering standards, design criteria, and permitting requirements.
Maintains advanced knowledge of California stormwater regulations, NPDES programs, and stormwater BMP requirements.
Identifies and resolves complex technical and regulatory challenges throughout project delivery.
Establishes and enforces QA/QC standards for engineering reports, plans, studies, and technical deliverables.
Promotes adherence to safety requirements, project standards, and engineering best practices.

Technical Leadership and Mentorship

Serves as a firm-wide technical resource for water resources and stormwater engineering.
Mentors junior and mid-level engineers in technical development, project execution, and professional growth.
Provides technical guidance, coaching, and constructive feedback to project teams.
Supports development of technical standards, best practices, and training initiatives.
Contributes to building technical depth and future leadership within the practice.

Innovation and Process Improvement

Evaluates and implements emerging technologies, analytical methods, and engineering tools to improve project outcomes and operational efficiency.
Develops methodologies, workflows, templates, and best practices that enhance technical quality and reduce project risk.
Champions continuous improvement initiatives across engineering and project delivery processes.
Remains current on industry trends, regulatory changes, and advancements in water resources and stormwater engineering.

Business Development and Industry Engagement

Develops and maintains strategic client relationships across public and private sectors.
Supports and leads proposal development, project pursuits, contract negotiations, and client presentations.
Identifies opportunities for business growth and revenue generation.
Develops scopes of work, schedules, budgets, and cost estimates for engineering services.
Represents the firm through professional organizations, industry events, conferences, and client engagements.
Contributes to Dudek's reputation as a leader in water resources and stormwater engineering.

Minimum Qualifications

Experience: 18+ years of experience in water resources, stormwater, civil, or environmental engineering, including progressive project management responsibilities.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
Licensure: Professional Engineer (PE) license in California or ability to obtain California licensure.
Advanced expertise in hydrology, hydraulics, floodplain analysis, stormwater engineering, drainage systems, grading design, and watershed management.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects, lead multidisciplinary teams, manage project financial performance, and deliver successful client outcomes.
Strong technical writing, communication, leadership, and client management skills.
Must possess a valid driver’s license and have active personal automobile liability insurance by the first day of employment

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of California municipal, construction, and industrial NPDES programs.
Experience with stormwater BMP design, flood mitigation planning, watershed studies, and drainage master planning.
Proficiency with ArcGIS, HEC-RAS, HEC-HMS, FLO-2D, SWMM, AutoCAD/Civil 3D, and other water resources modeling and design software.
Strong business development experience, including proposal leadership, client relationship management, and revenue generation.
Experience mentoring and developing engineering staff while maintaining high standards of technical quality and project delivery.

Compensation:
$150,000-$190,000 annually*
*Final agreed-upon compensation will be based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, an individual’s related experience, education, certifications, skills, and work location. Successful candidates must pass a pre-employment drug test and background check prior to beginning employment.
Working Conditions

This job operates in a remote or office-based environment and this role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, printers, etc.
This job requires occasional project site visits, based outdoors which can include excessive noise, uneven walking surfaces, extreme weather, and moving vehicles and equipment.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. This job requires the following:
Working on a computer, sitting, or standing for long periods of time in an office or remote office setting.
Attending meetings, both in person and virtually, and speaking on the phone with peers, clients, etc.
Specific vision abilities, including close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Environmental Engineering Projects
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 23640 

Department: Infrastructure & Water Services Dept.

Service: Infrastructure Services

Employment Type: 1 Full-time Temporary (up to 2 years) 

Work Hours: 35.00 hours per week

Affiliation: CIPP/CIPP

Salary Information: $93,764.58 - $114,097.62  annually (2025 rates of pay)

Location: 100 Constellation, Nepean  

Job Category: Engineering 

Application Close: 01/10/2026

Job Summary

Infrastructure Services delivers engineering programs and support services to the Infrastructure and Water Services department, including developing the corporate Asset Management strategy for water and wastewater treatment plants, pumping stations, reservoirs and facilities, capital project management services (facility and network), lifecycle performance optimization, energy efficiency and energy management initiatives, and efficiency improvements for water, wastewater, stormwater and solid waste programs.

You are responsible for managing total project delivery for projects oriented towards special studies, inspection, or service contracts with a focus on condition assessment, renewal or rehabilitation of facilities, linear networks physical infrastructure assets. The assigned work encompasses a broad range of studies, reports and projects that may typically be routine in nature, or specific in scope and of short duration.

Facilities may include:

For drinking water and waste water: Treatment plants, pumping stations, tanks, structure and force mains assets and related components such as pumps, valves and meters.
For solid waste: Landfill site(s) processes or transfer station assets

You: provide technical expertise and knowledge of the operational needs of the departmental clients through all phases of project delivery/lifecycle; participate in project identification/scoping, prioritization, planning and risk management; initiate/organize condition assessments and other studies relating to a project; monitor, track and report on project status; approve all project expenditures; and carry out related duties as assigned.

These positions are in the Design & Construction Water Facilities branch of Infrastructure Services, which focuses on infrastructure projects in the City’s water and wastewater facilities. The ideal candidate should have experience managing design and construction projects in operational facilities including drinking water treatment plants, wastewater treatment plants and water/wastewater pumping stations.

Education And Experience

Completion of 4 year university degree in Engineering or Applied Science specializing in one of the following: Mechanical, Electrical or Civil Engineering disciplines (as required for a specific facility or network work unit)

Minimum of 5 years of related and progressively responsible experience in a municipal engineering environment, in the planning, design, construction and rehabilitation of facilities or network (linear) physical infrastructure, including a minimum of 3 years construction project management experience.

CERTIFICATIONS AND LICENCES

Licensed Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) with Professional Engineers Ontario (PEO) is desirable

KNOWLEDGE

Planning, design and construction methods and practices and related federal, provincial and municipal legislation, and municipal engineering standards including legislation, standards, regulations and guidelines pertaining to water quality, potable water, sanitary, wastewater, and storm water services
Federal and provincial government legislation and regulatory requirements governing environmental issues and assessments, building/electrical/fire codes, and safety
In-depth knowledge of the City’s environmental services infrastructure and system components, including design, construction, operations and performance
Principles of project management, including cost containment/control, risk management and reporting

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Differentiated Security Team
jobs.description:
Description

Do you want to turn recurring security gaps into enterprise-wide solutions that protect millions of customers? As a Senior Technical Program Manager on Amazon's Differentiated Security Team, you will lead a program that identifies systemic security challenges surfaced through acquisitions and partner engagements, proves solutions work in real environments, and transitions them to long-term owners. This is a high-visibility role where you will define program strategy, influence senior leaders, and drive cross-functional delivery across security engineering, business security, and infrastructure teams. If you thrive in ambiguity, build consensus across organizations, and are energized by turning complex problems into simple, scalable solutions - we want to talk to you.

This is not a maintenance role. You will build the program's operational framework from the ground up by defining how security signals enter the pipeline, how initiatives are prioritized, and what "done" looks like. You will work at the intersection of mergers and acquisitions, security engineering, and enterprise infrastructure, giving you a vantage point into security challenges that most teams never see.

What Makes This Role Unique

You see security problems before anyone else. M&A integrations and partner engagements surface gaps in non-standard environments that standard security teams do not encounter
Every initiative has a finish line. You prove solutions work, then hand them off. You are a transient owner by design, not a permanent operator.
You shape the program, not just run it. The operational model, lifecycle framework, and prioritization rubric are being built now. You will have direct influence over how this program works for years to come
Your work has enterprise-wide impact. Solutions born from this program scale across dozens of business units and hundreds of thousands of applications.

Key job responsibilities

Own the end-to-end lifecycle of a security solutions program from signal identification through proof-of-concept, investment pitch, and transition to a funded long-term owner
Define program strategy, build prioritization mechanisms, and create measurable success criteria that keep a portfolio of concurrent initiatives on track
Drive cross-functional delivery across security engineering, business security, and infrastructure teams - often in environments with non-standard technology stacks
Write strategic narratives and present trade-offs, progress, and investment recommendations to Directors and VPs
Build mechanisms such as intake rubrics, initiative registries, and stage-gate frameworks that make the program repeatable and scalable beyond any single person.

A day in the life

You might start the morning facilitating a cross-functional design review to evaluate whether an existing security solution can close a newly identified gap, or whether a new approach is needed. After lunch, you could be writing an investment narrative to transition a validated solution to its long-term owner. When an active acquisition closes, you may step in as the integration TPM - coordinating security workstreams across engineering, infrastructure, and the acquired business to drive Day 1 readiness and post-close milestones. No two days look the same; the program spans concurrent initiatives at different lifecycle stages, and you keep them all moving forward.

About The Team

Our team enables Amazon to securely capture new revenue streams through mergers and acquisitions. We lead security integration for newly acquired businesses - coordinating across engineering, infrastructure, and compliance teams to drive risk reduction and security posture parity in environments where standard solutions do not yet reach. Our Security Initiatives program operates as a solution incubator: we identify systemic security challenges surfaced through acquisitions and partnerships, prove solutions work, and hand them to funded long-term owners. You will join a globally distributed team of security engineers and technical program managers who value data-driven decisions, partnership, and building durable capabilities for the enterprise.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
6+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
Experience leading highly technical programs involving infrastructure, complex systems, systems engineering
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience building and evaluating system-level technical design
Knowledge of information security principles, including risk management frameworks and security control domains (e.g., identity and access management, vulnerability management, incident response, cloud security)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing or supporting Mergers and Acquisitions security integration programs, including pre-close diligence coordination and post-close security onboarding
Experience leveraging AI-augmented tools or practices to accelerate security operations, risk scoring, or remediation workflows

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Architect & Program Manager
jobs.description:
Description

About The Role

The Senior Cloud Architect & Program Manager is a senior technical leadership role responsible for defining and executing the organization's cloud strategy, architecting scalable and secure cloud solutions and driving major modernization initiatives from concept through delivery. This role bridges enterprise architecture, project delivery, and cross-functional leadership — partnering with business and engineering teams to deliver cloud solutions that are cost-effective, resilient, and aligned with organizational priorities

Responsibilities

Cloud Strategy & Architecture

Define and maintain the organization's cloud strategy and long-term architectural roadmap
Design and implement scalable, secure, and resilient cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure.
Lead cloud architecture decisions across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS models.
Establish governance, security, and compliance frameworks for Azure environments.
Optimize cloud costs and performance through architecture reviews and automation.
Provide technical leadership on Azure migrations, hybrid cloud integrations, and DevOps enablement.

Program & Project Leadership

Lead the development and execution of coordinated, enterprise-scale plans and technology programs.
Drive high-priority, high-complexity projects requiring significant resources and cross-functional coordination.
Engage regularly with executive stakeholders to communicate program status, resolve escalations, and influence future technology initiatives.
Deliver clear, structured presentations on project status, risks, and outcomes to senior leadership.
Represent the Technology division in cross-departmental teams focused on key strategic initiatives.

Project & Delivery Management

Manage projects from inception through final implementation, coordinating across end users, vendors, and internal teams.
Define project scope, assign responsibilities, identify resources, and build schedules to ensure on-time delivery.
Manage project financials against assigned budgets: forecast requirements, track expenditures, analyze variances, and initiate corrective actions.
Ensure adherence to delivery standards and review all project deliverables for quality and completeness.
Identify and resolve risks for at-risk programs, organizing resources and solutions proactively.
Produce key project artifacts as needed — including business requirements documentation, project plans, test scripts, and change management logs.
Ensure all project information is current and accurate; provide regular high-level briefings to executive management.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, Communications, or a related field from an accredited institution.
10+ years of progressively responsible experience, with at least 5 years in Azure architecture or cloud leadership roles.
Proven track record managing multiple, complex enterprise-level technology projects simultaneously, including inter-dependent stakeholders across internal and external organizations.
Experience developing program and project strategies that achieve business goals, with demonstrated understanding of impacts on diverse stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams, including Regulatory Agencies and external partners.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to resolve issues that cross departmental boundaries.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with executive-level presentation ability.
Ability to travel to Port Authority facilities as required.

Desired Qualifications

Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer).
Experience with FinOps practices and cloud cost management frameworks.
Familiarity with government or regulated industry technology environments.
PMP, PgMP, or equivalent project management certification.

Selection Process

The application process varies by position, but typically includes an initial phone interview for qualified candidates, followed by a more in-depth interview(s) and/or assessment(s). Selected candidates who are made a conditional job offer will be asked to undergo a background check.

Compensation, Benefits & On-Site Collaboration Requirements

In accordance with Port Authority policy, this position permits employees to work remotely a maximum of one day per week, subject to operational and business needs.

The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey anticipates that the actual salary offered to a successful candidate will depend on aspects such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal factors.

The expected compensation range for this role is: Minimum: $ 147,290 Midpoint: $ 191,486 Maximum: $ 235,664

The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey offers a competitive benefits package and a professional environment that supports development and recognizes achievement.

Click here
for more information about benefits, our culture, and career development opportunities.

How To Apply

Interested candidates should apply to this job by clicking on the "Apply Now" button and submitting a resume. The Port Authority of NY & NJ welcomes veteran and military spouse applications.

Only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

About The Port Authority

Founded in 1921, the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey builds, operates, and maintains many of the most important transportation and trade infrastructure assets in the country. The agency's network of aviation, ground, rail, and seaport facilities is among the busiest in the country, supports more than 550,000 regional jobs, and generates more than twenty three billion in annual wages and eighty billion in annual economic activity. The Port Authority also owns and manages the 16-acre World Trade Center site, where the 1,776-foot-tall One World Trade Center is now the tallest skyscraper in the Western Hemisphere.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Job applicants may request a reasonable accommodation (1) if they claim a disability is affecting the interview process, or (2) to ensure that if they are selected for a position, they can perform the essential job functions. To submit a request, please contact the recruiter or email the Human Resources Department’s Disability Accommodation Coordinator at [email protected] .

Demonstrates a sense of urgency, commitment, and focus on the right priorities in developing solutions in a timely fashion

. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank—and we need talent like you to help us get there.

Are you passionate about international trade
? Do you have experience in Structured Trade Finance solutions
? Do you enjoy collaborating with diverse teams across countries and functions? If you answered yes, we want to hear from you.

What you will do

Global Trade Solutions (GTS)
comprises 4,500+ colleagues across 50+ countries
, supporting suppliers and buyers with export and import finance needs. Trade is where HSBC began in 1865
, when we financed commerce between Europe and Asia.

The purpose of this role is to lead the successful end-to-end implementation of Global Trade Solutions deals
, including onboarding of complex deals across the GTS product suite for clients located across European geographies. You’ll drive delivery from client kick-off through funding, including scoping and Statement of Work
creation, using proven methodologies to deliver a high-quality client experience while accelerating revenue realisation for the bank.

In this role you will

Lead end-to-end implementation of Structured Finance deals and selected Core Trade products
Partner closely with Sales, Operations, Technology and Services, providing implementation consultancy to clients
Manage project delivery and technical onboarding, including UAT and PVT testing to complete programme set-up successfully
Build strong working relationships with key stakeholders across GTS Frontline/Structuring, Coverage (including senior management), IT, Change Delivery, Service Delivery, and global functions (e.g., Risk, Finance)
Drive cross-business collaboration to ensure strategy alignment, improve efficiency, and share best practices with appropriate senior escalation
Project manage multiple deals/programmes concurrently, acting as the central point of contact for internal and external stakeholders
Develop and execute implementation plans using structured project management methodologies; guide clients on responsibilities and tasks within the plan
Host and attend regular client meetings to track progress, provide accurate status updates, and escalate risks/issues impacting client experience

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Maritime
jobs.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn , X , Instagram , and YouTube .

We are looking for an exceptional Senior Staff Technical Program Manager to join our Maritime Domain team, integrating Shield AI’s Hivemind Autonomy stack onto Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USVs) and, in the future, Unmanned Undersea Vehicles (UUVs). Your role will include starting programs from the ground up and guiding them through production and into operational employment. This role requires a self-starter who can integrate quickly with a fast-moving, highly competent team.

You will drive alignment across software development and integration activities with domestic and international customers while remaining synchronized with Business Development colleagues. This role requires close coordination with colleagues across Shield AI’s international teams, including offices in Europe and Asia, and a motivated, cross-functional leadership approach.

The ideal candidate has a combination of government and commercial program management experience, with strong, established fundamentals in coordinating complex, first-of-a-kind integration efforts. You will be responsible for driving cost, schedule, integration readiness, risk management, and successful operational outcomes while pushing the boundaries of maritime autonomy. We are looking for a candidate who can think critically and creatively while leveraging a firm foundation in managing risk across new and foundational programs.

What you'll do:

Lead Assigned Unmanned Surface Vehicle (USV) Autonomy and Future Unmanned Undersea Vehicle (UUV) Integration Programs

Serve as the program manager for assigned USV programs, leading the integration of Shield AI’s Hivemind autonomy software onto USV platforms.
Support the development and execution of future UUV autonomy integration programs as opportunities mature.

Establish Clear Objectives

Work closely with product managers, engineering leads, operations, and executive leadership to define clear program objectives tied to mission impact, customer success, strategic growth, financial outcomes, and technical performance.

Program & Project Management

Own the development and execution of integrated program and project plans, including scope, schedules, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and resource allocation. Continuously evaluate and rebalance customer priorities, technical risks, cost constraints, and schedule demands throughout the program.

Drive Timely, High-Quality Decisions

Facilitate rigorous, fast, and effective technical and programmatic decision-making across cross-functional teams. While not expected to design systems directly, you will possess sufficient technical depth to identify risks, challenge assumptions, and drive alignment. Hands-on experience with software or autonomy products is an accelerator.

Integration & Test Readiness

Coordinate system integration activities across labs, ground testing, and sea trial operations. Drive readiness reviews, integration milestones, and closure of technical dependencies required to support successful USV/UUV integration and operational deployment.
Identify potential bottlenecks, critical-path risks, and schedule delays, and drive mitigation strategies to achieve program milestones and delivery commitments. Conduct critical-path analyses and support program execution through Gate Reviews, Program Management Reviews (PMRs), and Estimates at Completion (EACs).

Communicate with Excellence

Drive a consistent cadence of well-organized, effective meetings, including preparation, facilitation, action tracking, and follow-up. Ensure stakeholders remain aligned on status, milestones, priorities, risks, integration readiness, and technical challenges.

Drive Technical Execution

Support the development and refinement of technical and operational documentation, engineering change orders, work instructions, service bulletins, operational procedures, and integration documentation.

Empower Teams & Remove Obstacles

Create an environment where teams have the clarity, tools, accountability, and support needed to execute effectively. Escalate issues quickly, streamline processes, eliminate blockers, and foster a culture of ownership, urgency, and continuous improvement.

Deliver Outcomes

Drive accurate and timely tracking and reporting of program financials, resources, schedules, integration status, and customer deliverables.

Support Growth & Strategic Initiatives

Support business development activities related to current and future autonomy integration programs, including proposals, requests for information (RFIs), requests for proposals (RFPs), technical evaluations, and strategic customer engagements.

Required qualifications:

Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 9 years and a Master’s degree; or 7 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience.
Experience leading complex cross-functional engineering programs from concept through production and operational deployment.
Strong technical understanding of software-enabled systems, autonomy, aerospace systems, or complex integrated products.
Demonstrated success managing program execution across scope, schedule, budget, risk, and technical performance in fast-paced environments.
Experience with Program Management Reviews (PMRs), gate reviews, and estimates.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead through influence across distributed teams.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills in fast-paced environments.
Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and ability to drive execution with high standards and collaboration.
Willingness to travel internationally

Preferred qualifications:

Experience integrating autonomy or software systems onto defense platforms.
Experience in software development, autonomy development, or systems engineering.
Experience managing clean-sheet defense or technology development programs.
PMP and/or Certified Scrum Master (CSM) certification.
Familiarity with DoD contracting, defense acquisition, or national security programs.
Experience balancing aggressive timelines with complex engineering constraints.
Eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret clearance or higher.

Description

Leidos is seeking a proven technical program management leader with deep experience leading large‑scale mission software development, full‑lifecycle modernization
, and distributed engineering organizations.
The ideal candidate has directed complex software programs
, overseen multi‑discipline teams delivering secure, high‑performance capabilities, and demonstrated authoritative leadership across architecture, integration, DevOps, cyber, and cloud environments. Candidates must bring hands‑on credibility in software development and sustainment, not just program oversight, with a track record of delivering mission‑critical systems for the Department of Defense and Intelligence Community.

This role requires meaningful technical credibility, disciplined program leadership, and demonstrated success running large‑scale, full‑lifecycle software development and sustainment programs exceeding $20M/year. Consider that Mission System Modernization is a continually challenging requirement that demands modernization of legacy mission systems into secure cloud, hybrid, or containerized architectures, ensuring resilience, scalability, and future ready capability delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Program Leadership of Large-Scale Program: Direct full‑lifecycle development, integration, deployment, and sustainment of mission software systems spanning analytics, cyber, geospatial, and enterprise data workflows.
Mission‑Critical Delivery: Oversee development and sustainment of classified systems of systems supporting warfighter intelligence, operational planning, and strategic decision‑making using Agile Execution methodologies and strategies to implement and enforce enterprise Agile practices, Program Increment Planning, CI/CD pipelines, and rapid prototyping methodologies across distributed teams.
Customer Engagement & Strategy: Serve as the autonomous senior interface to government sponsors, shaping technical direction, resolving issues, and driving mission‑aligned growth.
Program Leadership: Develop and execute program with disciplined accountability of technical, schedule, and financial matters to maintain performance baselines and embolden customer confidence.
Innovation & Prototyping: Drive rapid prototyping, IR&D initiatives, and technical fellowship‑level solutioning to accelerate mission capability insertion and expand program growth opportunities.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree and 15+ years of experience in software‑intensive program leadership; or Master’s degree with 12+ years; or equivalent experience.
Active TS/SCI with ability to obtain a polygraph once hired.
Demonstrated leadership of large, geographically distributed engineering organizations delivering mission software across classified and unclassified environments. Distribution must be at least two or more physically/geographically separated locations.
Proven success managing $20M+/year software development and sustainment portfolios.
Deep experience with full‑stack software development, DevOps, CI/CD, cloud, cyber, and enterprise data systems.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills spanning technical, operational, and executive audiences.
Experience supporting business development, technical solutioning, and major proposal efforts with hands on knowledge/development of BOEs, RFP/RFI response generation.

Preferred Qualifications

Active TS/SCI with polygraph.
Experience delivering mission‑critical classified systems for the Department of Defense and Intelligence Community.
Background in software architecture, cyber innovation, AI/ML integration, modeling/simulation, or enterprise modernization.
Experience leading multi‑discipline teams of 100+ personnel across diverse technical domains.
Demonstrated ability to recover troubled programs, re‑establish technical execution, and deliver under high‑visibility conditions.
Experience driving IR&D, rapid prototyping, and technical innovation pipelines aligned to mission needs.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Software
jobs.description:
Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.

With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future-proof, backwards-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.

Overview

As Software TPM
, you'll own the execution of our software programs across navigation service, mission operations, and flight software -- working closely with our program lead and engineering teams to keep a fast-moving, highly interdependent software organization on track. Beyond running the program, you'll also build the connective tissue -- tooling, automation, and reporting.

We're looking for someone who is software-first -- you think in releases, dependencies, and code -- but who is genuinely comfortable stepping into hardware territory: sitting in on bus/payload reviews, understanding integration and test constraints, and covering for the Satellite TPM when programs need an extra set of hands. If you want real ownership, proximity to the code and the constellation, and a chance to build both the program and the systems that run it, this role is for you!

Responsibilities

Software Schedule Ownership: Own and maintain the software development schedule across Nav Service, Mission Ops, and flight software (GNC, FSW, payload core), tracking progress against milestones, managing critical path, and keeping the program honest -- especially through the transition from Design/Build/Test into on-orbit operations
Cross-Functional Coordination: Serve as the program hub across Nav Service, Mission Ops, and flight software teams -- translating technical progress into shared plans and clear accountability. Partner tightly with the Satellite TPM to keep software and hardware programs in sync at every shared interface (software readiness, bus interfaces, on-orbit test campaigns).
Release & Dependency Management: Support release management and dependency tracking across all software teams, ensuring releases are coordinated, tested, and deployed without surprises to downstream teams or live operations
System Automation & Tooling: Identify manual operational overhead across teams and build the lightweight tooling, bots, and integrations to eliminate it -- connecting platforms like GitHub/GitLab, Wrike/Linear, Teams, and monitoring tools into a single source of operational truth
Risk & Issue Resolution: Surface risks early, maintain the risk register, and work directly with technical leads to resolve blockers before they hit the schedule. Escalate to program leadership with context and a recommended path forward.
Program Reporting: Prepare and deliver regular software program status to leadership, maintaining a clear and accurate picture of schedule health, open risks, delivery predictability, and upcoming decisions -- automating this reporting wherever possible so status is always current, not just current when someone asks
Process Building: Help develop lightweight, effective program management processes suited to a small team moving fast -- minimizing meeting bloat through automation and async workflows, with real input into how TPM operates at Xona
Hardware Fluency & Flex Coverage: Maintain working fluency in bus and payload development -- enough to sit credibly in integration and test reviews, understand how hardware milestones affect your software schedule, and step in on hardware program coordination or backfill the Satellite TPM when the program needs it

Required Qualifications

4–7 years of program or project management experience in complex software development, with meaningful exposure to aerospace, robotics, or another hardware-adjacent technical field
Direct experience program-managing software teams through both active development and live/operational phases -- you understand that priorities, cadence, and risk look different once something is running in production (or in orbit)
Strong systems thinker who can track interdependencies across multiple software workstreams -- and their interfaces with hardware -- without losing the critical path
Comfortable operating in hardware environments -- you don't need to have owned a bus or payload schedule, but you've been close to spacecraft, robotics, or other complex hardware programs that avionics, RF, or integration/test
Proficient enough as a programmer (Python, TypeScript/Node.js, or Go) to build and deploy lightweight internal tools, bots, and automations yourself
Self-directed and comfortable operating with limited oversight
Clear communicator who can work credibly with engineers and summarize status cleanly for leadership

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with GNSS, PNT systems, or mission operations concepts (telemetry, commanding, ground segment software, on-orbit anomaly response)
Experience building bots, custom integrations across developer toolchains (GitHub, Linear/Wrike, Teams, Datadog, AWS/GCP), or internal developer portals
Hands-on experience with satellite bus subsystems or RF/navigation payloads, or having worked through a full satellite program cycle from PDR/CDR through integration, test, and launch/operations
Hands-on knowledge of workflow automation platforms (Temporal, n8n, Airflow, or similar)
Prior experience as a software engineer or DevOps engineer before moving into technical program management
PMP, Agile, or other PM certifications (nice to have, not a substitute for real program experience)

For U.S. Roles:
To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

For U.K. Roles:
To comply with U.K. regulations, this role requires Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks, and successful candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC).

For Canada Roles:
Successful candidates must obtain and hold a security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and ITAR.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Are you ready to join a fast-paced, innovative team making a real impact in the renewable energy industry? Join Shoals Technologies Group (NASDAQ: SHLS), a leading provider of electrical balance of systems (EBOS) solutions for solar and energy storage. Headquartered just north of Nashville, Tennessee, we have been driving industry innovation since 1996 by delivering cutting-edge technologies that improve efficiency, safety, and reliability for solar systems worldwide. With over 60 GW of solar systems deployed globally, we’re setting the standard for the renewable energy industry.

We are a collection of engineers, renewable advocates, curious minds, and collaborators. Our manufacturing facilities in Tennessee and Alabama, along with sales teams across Spain and Australia, enable us to power clean energy solutions across Europe, Latin America, Africa, and Asia-Pacific. We push boundaries and challenge each other to design, develop, and deliver solutions with the potential to change the world. We are the rebellious hero.

Summary

The Project Manager at Shoals will provide leadership and direction to cross-functional teams comprised of users, business stakeholders, IT, vendors, and other stakeholders. This role will be a member of the Shoals PMO and help manage the project portfolio. As Shoals transitions to a more Agile way of delivery, we will require a hybrid Agile approach. It will require the use of good judgement and skill to develop a project management approach that is suitable for planning and managing the effort. The role will also require a consultative approach to engage the appropriate people, processes, tools and to improve efficiency and effectiveness. The Project Manager will collaborate with the stakeholders (IT Product Managers, Executives, Directors, etc.) to successfully deliver on the projects and capabilities for each domain. This role will also act as a team builder to promote empowerment of the team, creating a safe environment for failing fast and learning, engagement and participation of team members and encourage a sustainable pace that can maintain quality.

Responsibilities

Manage the full project lifecycle, from planning and development to implementation and closure.
Create project and work plans.
Coordinate and supervise activities of the teams to ensure seamless collaboration.
Communicate regularly with stakeholders, providing updates on project status, presentations, and technical insights as required.
Collaborate with the vendor(s), team and product manager(s) to understand the impact of changes on capacity and timeline.
Oversee the planning, scheduling, and tracking of project timelines and milestones using appropriate tools.
Identify, assess, and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Proactively refine backlog(s) so requirements, resources, or infrastructure gaps for the highest priority work is identified and resolved prior to the start of the sprint.
Ensure that all requirements, project plans, and changes to commitment are communicated to all affected stakeholders.
Measure and monitor progress at clearly defined points in the process and take corrective actions, as needed, to deliver the project on time, and within budget.
Proactively remove blocking issues within and external to teams.
Provide oversight and implement control processes for management of project scope, schedule, and budget.
Coordinate and ensure completion of all deliverables from the various teams to accompany go-live dates, releases, etc.
Organize and lead project status, working meetings, and scrum ceremonies.
Champion the adoption of Agile across the organization, providing coaching and training to team members to enhance their understanding and execution of these methodologies.
Maintain a high standard of professional conduct and leadership, setting an example for team members.

Qualifications

Expert knowledge of both Agile and traditional project management principles and practices and the ability to blend them together in the right proportions to fit a project and business environment
A proven track record of successfully implementing software or web development projects using Agile methodologies including minimum 8+ years of experience as a Project Manager managing large, complex technical projects in an environment with multi-function teams. PMP preferred
Prior experience with SCRUM/Agile methodologies with enterprise-level projects. PMI-ACP, CSM, or equivalent preferred
Experience overseeing multi-function project teams with at least 10-15 team members including Business Stakeholders, Users, Developers, Business Analysts, and QA Personnel
Balanced business/technical background:
Sufficient level of technical background to provide highly credible leadership to technical teams and to be able to accurately and objectively evaluate complex project risks and issues
Ability to provide leadership to business analysts and collaborate with customers and develop strategies and solutions of high business value

Skills Required

BA or BS or equivalent experience is required; MA or MS is a plus
Very effective interpersonal skills including mentoring, coaching, collaborating, and team building
Strong analytical, planning, and organizational skills with an ability to manage competing demands
In-depth knowledge and understanding of business needs with the ability to establish/maintain high level of customer trust and confidence
Proven ability to lead software implementation/integration/development projects and ensure objectives, goals, and commitments are met
Solid understanding of and demonstrated experience in using appropriate tools:
Agile Project Management tools such as Jira, Rally, Azure DevOps, VersionOne or equivalent
Microsoft Project, Visio, and other MS Office Tools
Excellent oral and written communications skills and experience interacting with both business and IT individuals at all levels including the executive level
Creative approach to problem-solving with the ability to focus on details while maintaining the “big picture” view

jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Security is hiring a Physical Security Program Manager to own security system installation during end-to-end data center construction. You will manage security vendors from request for quotation stage through project completion. You will review designs, validate installations, and accept systems. You will ensure every site meets AWS Physical Security Standards before handoff to operations.

Key job responsibilities

Own the end-to-end deployment lifecycle for physical security systems (including but not limited to access control, intrusion detection, video surveillance systems and supporting components) — from staging and pre-configuration through installation oversight, integration verification, and operational handoff.

Conduct comprehensive due diligence on proposed security system designs, vendor solutions, and site conditions to identify risks, gaps, and opportunities prior to project initiation.

Perform site assessments and feasibility analyses to validate that proposed security architectures meet AWS Physical Security Standards and local regulatory requirements.

Execute reviews of security system drawings, markups, and submittals; provide detailed technical feedback to design engineers and vendors to drive design accuracy and compliance.

Develop and validate programming logic for access control systems, intrusion detection panels, video management systems, and integrated alarm platforms to ensure systems operate per AWS security requirements.

Serve as the escalation point for complex (Level 2/Level 3) physical security system issues — diagnosing root causes across hardware, software, network, and integration layers.

Lead physical security integration testing and validate testing events; document & track results, punch list items, and acceptance criteria to ensure systems meet operational readiness standards prior to handoff.

Document & track vendor performance: installation quality, service delivery, equipment reliability, verify accuracy of quotes, contractual requirements/deliverables.

Evaluate competing priorities, technical constraints, and business requirements to make sound engineering decisions under ambiguity and time pressure.

About The Team

AWS Infrastructure Security designs, builds, and operates all AWS global infrastructure. We work on the most challenging problems in an environment where scale never stops growing — and we're looking for technical builders who can anticipate what's next, adapt to the demands of hyperscale infrastructure, and engineer solutions today that will protect tomorrow's data centers.

Experience acting as a Program Security Officer, Security Specialist, or Security Manager with duties including interpreting and implementing requirements within the personnel, industrial, and physical security disciplines and overseeing security operations

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working on physical security design and implementation of Access Control/Intrusion Detection and CCTV Surveillance systems

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Field Integration and Testing , Amazon Leo
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

Within the Experience Validation organization, the Field Integration and Testing (FIT) team pioneers end-to-end network field validation—testing Leo's full signal path from the customer terminal through gateway infrastructure to the internet, in real customer environments that labs cannot fully replicate. We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive the execution of FIT's core testing operations and its international expansion as Leo scales across territories and new hardware. You will be the connective tissue between FIT, Leo engineering, the Beta teams, and the Amazon Devices Field Quality Engineering (FQE) partnership, keeping test coverage aligned with a fast-moving release cadence of new customer terminals, firmware, and mobile app builds.

Key job responsibilities

In this role, you will own the program mechanics across FIT's three prioritized workstreams. For core operations, you will coordinate pre-release testing of new hardware and app releases before they reach Beta cohorts, create and drive resolution of bugs and quality issues, and track the health and uptime of the Solution Lab CT fleet as a shared resource for Leo teams. You will coordinate execution of country-specific functional test cases (e.g. regional IP routing, KPOP routing, Legal Interception) and B2B use cases—across Solution Labs in the Americas and EMEA, and support Solution Lab and demo center expansion into future markets. In the process ou will help operationalize the FQE partnership so expert testers can be dispatched to any country on short notice. Throughout, you will manage schedules, dependencies (including Beta Ops provisioning, hardware delivery, and spot enablement), open items, and risks, and maintain clear, data-backed status for leadership.

Success in this role requires strong technical program management judgment, comfort with networking and connectivity concepts, and the ability to coordinate many moving parts across teams, vendors, and geographies. You will define and report the metrics that show testing is on track and you anticipate dependencies and risks before they slip. You will write and communicate crisp and concise updates The ideal candidate is a hands-on, highly organized TPM who thrives in ambiguity, is comfortable working closely with engineers and field testers on production hardware and real integrations, and is energized by the challenge of proving out a brand-new satellite connectivity experience country by country.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life

You start your morning reviewing program dashboards and triaging any overnight issues that need immediate attention. By mid-morning you are leading a cross-team sync, aligning engineers and product partners on upcoming milestones and surfacing risks early. After lunch you might deep-dive into a technical design review, asking the right questions to ensure the proposed solution accounts for upstream and downstream impacts. Later, you draft a status narrative for leadership, distilling complex details into a clear story that drives decisions.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of technical product or program management experience
2+ years of software development experience
3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Working knowledge of networking or connectivity concepts (e.g., IP routing, DNS, DHCP, latency, packet loss, VPN)

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Experience in satellite, telecommunications, wireless/RF, networking, or other connectivity/hardware domains
Experience managing test, integration, verification, or field-testing programs involving physical hardware and third-party equipment
Experience with defect/bug management processes and driving issues to resolution with engineering teams
Experience coordinating lab operations or distributed field testing across multiple countries
Familiarity with regulatory/compliance verification (e.g., lawful interception, RF compliance) or B2B/enterprise connectivity (AWS Direct Connect, enterprise routers)
Experience standing up or scaling operational programs into new international regions
Experience defining Go/No-Go or launch-readiness frameworks

jobs.title: Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
Company Overview

ID.me is the next-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Consumers can verify their identity with ID.me once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 152 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with ID.me at 20 federal agencies, 45 state government agencies, and 70+ healthcare organizations. More than 600+ consumer brands use ID.me to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. ID.me’s technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800-63-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. ID.me is committed to “No Identity Left Behind” to enable all people to have a secure digital identity. To learn more, visit https://network.id.me/.

ID.me is a full-time, in-office culture. Unless a specific job description explicitly states otherwise, all roles are on-site five days per week at one of our offices in McLean, VA; Mountain View, CA; New York City, NY; or Tampa, FL. Certain roles — such as field-based sales or other remote-by-design positions — may have different work arrangements as noted in their individual postings.

At ID.me, we embrace the thoughtful use of AI tools in our daily work and there are even occasions where we leverage AI in our hiring process. However, during the interview process, we want to understand your individual skills and experiences. Therefore, we have guidelines on how AI can be appropriately used during your application and interviews which can be found here.

ID.me is looking for a senior threat intelligence professional to lead technical tracking of the adversaries targeting the identity verification ecosystem, and to turn that tracking into decisions the business acts on. Identity fraud is an industrialized market of credential and document vendors, injection and deepfake tooling, synthetic identity brokers, and organized account takeover crews. This role sits directly across from it.

You will own intelligence coverage for a defined set of threats end to end: setting the collection strategy, running the research, building the models and tooling, and delivering the finished product to the people who need it, from detection engineers to executives and government partners. This is a senior individual-contributor role with high autonomy and real influence over security and product direction. You will also be a technical mentor to the analysts around you and a standard-setter for how the team does analysis.

Responsibilities

Own an intelligence portfolio. Take end-to-end responsibility for tracking a set of threat actors, fraud typologies, or ecosystems targeting ID.me and our partners, from collection through analysis to delivery and follow-up.
Set collection strategy. Define and prioritize intelligence requirements in partnership with security, fraud, product, and company leadership. Identify gaps in current coverage and close them.
Run technical collection at depth. Conduct sustained collection and source development across deep and dark web forums, illicit marketplaces, encrypted messaging platforms, and closed communities, using sound tradecraft and operational security.
Hunt emerging activity. Proactively hunt for new actor activity, tooling, and TTPs across internal telemetry and external sources, and pull threads before they become incidents.
Produce finished intelligence. Write assessments that hold up to scrutiny, with clear judgments, stated confidence levels, articulated assumptions, and specific recommendations, for audiences ranging from engineers to the executive team to external partners.
Make intelligence operational. Convert research into detections, fraud signals, blocklists, enrichment, and platform data. Work with detection engineering, data science, and product to get it deployed and measure whether it worked.
Advance the team's analytic tradecraft. Improve threat modeling standards, structured analytic methods, reporting templates, source evaluation, and the team's use of frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and the Diamond Model.
Build tooling and automation. Identify where manual work is limiting coverage and build or specify the tooling, pipelines, and enrichment to remove it.
Mentor and raise the bar. Coach analysts on collection tradecraft, analytic writing, and structured analysis. Review their work and help develop their judgment.
Represent the function. Brief senior leadership, partners, and where appropriate, industry peer groups, law enforcement, and information-sharing communities.

Qualifications

5+ years of experience in threat intelligence, cyber threat hunting, fraud intelligence, or a closely related discipline, including experience producing finished intelligence for decision-makers.
3+ years of hands-on collection across the deep and dark web, including illicit marketplaces and encrypted communication platforms, with demonstrated tradecraft and operational security practices.
Deep, applied experience with common analysis models and frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, the Diamond Model, kill chain, structured analytic techniques). Not just familiarity, but a track record of using them to reach and defend analytic judgments.
Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous, fragmentary, and conflicting information and produce a clear assessment with appropriately expressed confidence.
Exceptional written and verbal communication, including experience writing for both deeply technical and executive audiences.
Track record of working independently: scoping your own problems, setting priorities, and driving work to a result without close direction.
Proven ability to influence stakeholders outside of security, and to translate intelligence into changes other teams actually make.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with identity fraud, account takeover, synthetic identity, document and biometric fraud, or the fraud-as-a-service ecosystem.
Strong SQL skills for independent data analysis at scale, and scripting in Python or similar for collection, enrichment, and automation.
Experience turning intelligence into production detections or fraud controls alongside engineering and data science teams.
Experience mentoring analysts or leading intelligence projects across multiple contributors.
Relevant certifications such as GCTI, GREM, GCFA, GOSI, CISSP, or Security+.
Working proficiency in a foreign language relevant to threat actor communities.
Experience in a regulated or government-facing environment, or supporting external partners with intelligence products.
