With data fusion and mission management capabilities for the Department of Defense, the combatant commands and the intelligence community, HII advances the mission around the globe.

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies

Role

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

Know & Grow Your People – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
Build Relationships – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
Take Ownership – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
Customer First – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
Shape the Future – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
Act with Urgency – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Who We Are

HII-Mission Technologies is seeking a Small Business Innovation Research/ Small Business Technology Transfer (SBIR/STTR) Due Diligence Specialist to serve in the Office of National Security (ONS), within the Immediate Office of the Secretary at the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS). The specialist will support ONS by conducting national security due diligence and research security assessments of SBIR/STTR companies, key personnel, researchers, and affiliated entities to identify foreign ownership, control, or influence (FOCI), foreign affiliations, research security concerns, supply chain vulnerabilities, technology transfer risks, and other national security indicators. The specialist will leverage commercial data sources, open-source information, U.S. Government information, and, when authorized, classified reporting to assess corporate ownership, investment and financial relationships, researcher affiliations, intellectual property, foreign collaborations, and related risks, while supporting the development of standardized risk-based screening, enhanced due diligence, case management, and analytic methodologies across HHS SBIR/STTR programs.

ONS provides Counterintelligence, Intelligence, and administrative support to customers within HHS. This role will fall under the Identity Intelligence Division and will focus on providing intelligence analysis and support related to Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) portfolio to senior HHS leaders.

What You Will Do

The selected candidate will support the Office of National Security (ONS) in identifying and assessing national security, supply chain, research security, and foreign influence risks associated with HHS SBIR/STTR applicants and awardees. The analyst will conduct comprehensive due diligence and all-source analysis of companies, technologies, key personnel, investors, and research partners, examining foreign ownership, control and influence, corporate structures, beneficial ownership, investments, affiliations, research collaborations, intellectual property, patents and publications, technology transfer, supply-chain dependencies, and connections to foreign governments or entities of national security concern. Using government holdings, commercial datasets, corporate and financial records, scientific and technical databases, and open-source information, the analyst will conduct corporate and identity resolution, network and link analysis, ownership and investment mapping, and research, technology, and supply-chain analysis to identify non-obvious relationships and risk indicators. The analyst will produce clear, defensible SCRM and national security risk assessments to inform HHS funding, mitigation, and risk-management decisions; support continuous vetting of selected awardees for material changes in risk; and collaborate with HHS program, grants, acquisition, research security, counterintelligence, Intelligence Community, law enforcement, and interagency partners to protect HHS-funded research, emerging technologies, intellectual property, supply chains, and national security equities.

What We Are Looking For

5 years relevant experience with Bachelors in a related field; 3 years of experience with Masters in a related field; or a High School Diploma or equivalent and 9 years relevant experience
Possess and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance
Targeting & Networks: Experience conducting targeting, identity resolution, and link analysis to identify individuals, entities, foreign affiliations, networks, and non-obvious relationships
Corporate & Financial Analysis: Ability to assess corporate structures, beneficial ownership, investments, funding sources, key personnel, and foreign relationships for national security risks
Supply Chain Risk: Experience identifying foreign suppliers, dependencies, affiliates, technology providers, and other supply-chain relationships presenting operational or national security vulnerabilities
Research Security: Knowledge of foreign influence, technology transfer, non-traditional collection, intellectual property threats, talent programs, research relationships, and dual-use technologies
SCRM: Understanding of counterintelligence and national security risks affecting SCRM programs, federally funded research, small businesses, and the U.S. innovation ecosystem
Analytic Tradecraft: Ability to evaluate sources, identify intelligence gaps, test hypotheses, recognize anomalies, assess alternatives, and develop defensible analytic judgments
Risk-Based Vetting: Experience applying risk-based screening, enhanced due diligence, continuous vetting, targeted collection, mitigation, monitoring, and referral methodologies
Intelligence Production: Ability to produce and brief concise intelligence assessments, targeting products, SCRM findings, and risk recommendations for senior decision-makers
Must be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and have a working knowledge of Adobe Acrobat

Preferred: Bonus Points For...

SBIR/STTR & Research Security: Experience supporting SBIR/STTR screening, due diligence, SCRM, research security, grant reviews, and applicable foreign-risk policies
Emerging Technology: Experience assessing biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, AI, cybersecurity, advanced manufacturing, genomics, synthetic biology, and other emerging or dual-use technologies
Corporate & Intelligence Tools: Experience using commercial intelligence platforms to assess ownership, investment, supply chains, research networks, patents, publications, and technology-transfer pathways
Foreign Threats & Continuous Vetting: Knowledge of foreign technology acquisition, talent programs, state-linked entities, and continuous monitoring of ownership, affiliations, personnel, and investments
Risk Management & Communication: Experience developing risk indicators, mitigation recommendations, analytic workflows, and assessments while briefing stakeholders and appropriately handling classified information

Physical Requirements

Job performance will normally require only minor lifting and carrying of boxes of records or equipment

This role includes work in TASB’s Risk Management Services division, which provides administrative services to the TASB Risk Management Fund – a multi-line self-insurance pool (or “risk pool”) of Texas schools. About You

Compiling and analyzing data from multiple internal and external sources to identify trends, monitor performance, and provide actionable business insights.

Monitoring claims, underwriting, financial, operational, and member service performance through established reporting tools and methodologies.
Validating, reconciling, and quality-checking data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability across systems and reporting environments.
Collaborating with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs and translate business questions into meaningful analytical solutions.
Developing and enhancing dashboards, reports, and visualizations that help stakeholders track performance and make informed decisions.
Investigating data issues and partnering with cross-functional teams to resolve data quality, processing, or integration challenges.

If you’re still reading, we’d love to meet you!

How You’ll Make An Impact

In this role, you will play a key part in helping Risk Management Services leverage data as a strategic asset. Your work will directly contribute to improving business outcomes, operational efficiency, and decision-making by:

Applying statistical methods, quantitative analysis, and analytical models to evaluate Fund performance and identify emerging risks and opportunities.
Supporting data-driven decision-making through meaningful reporting, trend analysis, forecasting, and performance measurement.
Partnering with managers and staff across Risk Management Services to deliver analyses that support operational, financial, and strategic objectives.
Recommending performance measures, metrics, and reporting solutions that provide greater visibility into business operations.
Participating in data modernization, reporting enhancement, and business intelligence initiatives that improve organizational effectiveness.
Helping ensure that leaders and business partners have timely, accurate, and actionable information to guide decision-making.
Preparing presentations, executive summaries, and visual reports that clearly communicate findings and recommendations.

Skills Or Requirements For Success

Successful candidates bring strong quantitative abilities, curiosity, and a passion for transforming data into actionable insights, including:

Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Actuarial Science, Economics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
One to two years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, statistical analysis, reporting, or a related discipline.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, data modeling, macro development, complex formulas, and analytical functions.
Experience querying and analyzing data using SQL or a similar data programming language.
Understanding of relational databases, data structures, and normalization principles.
Experience developing dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau, Business Objects, or similar business intelligence tools.
Familiarity with Python, R, VBA, or other programming and statistical analysis languages preferred.
Interest in predictive analytics, statistical modeling, machine learning, or artificial intelligence applications preferred.

Enjoy competitive pay and rich benefit offerings.
Be a part of a collaborative environment where every contribution impact Texas public schools.

Learn and grow individually and together through frequent professional development, wellness seminars, and more.

Celebrate as a team with meaningful (and fun) events throughout the year.

Sens du résultat et orientation solution ;

Aisance relationnelle et goût du travail en équipe ;

Capacité à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs métiers et à transformer les données en recommandations opérationnelles.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone with strong data skills and a passion for sustainability to help map regulatory obligations, analyze packaging and sales data, and support reporting that drives compliance and environmental improvement across our business. You will collaborate with internal teams and external consultants to ensure accurate data collection, reporting, and insight generation.

Solstice Advanced Materials is looking for a Data Analyst to
support our Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)
program across the EU and UK / US.

You will collaborate with internal teams and external consultants to ensure accurate data collection, reporting, and insight generation.

This role can be located in Morris Plains, NJ or Geismar, LA.

Key Responsibilities

Map and track EPR obligations across Solstice businesses in the EU and UK / across US States and Canada
Collect, validate, and analyze packaging, sales, and environmental data
Investigate and implement alternative compliant packaging types [ FF1] in partnership with Logistics and Manufacturing organizations
Support regulatory reporting and monthly leadership reporting
Maintain accurate data within EPR management systems and reporting tools

jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to become Earth's most customer-centric company and to grow in a safe environment for both our customers and our associates. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, dynamic, and passionate people.

The Dangerous Goods (DG) team is looking for a motivated Senior Program Manager with strong regulatory experience, operational knowledge, logistics experience, and a hands-on passion to dive deep into processes that support Amazon's growth in a safe environment for customers, partners, and associates.

Working across procurement, transportation services, delivery experience, returns and re-commerce, technology, storage, legal, public policy, and other relevant internal teams on a global scale, this Senior Program Manager will ensure the safety of our associates and transportation partners by delivering innovative solutions for the safe and compliant transportation of DG, redefining industry best practices and standards, and safely enabling an ever-changing borderless business model.

This Senior Program Manager will plan and execute DG policies, controls, and processes to ensure the safe and compliant transportation of DG across a global supply chain. Working collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders, consultants, and regulators, this role will drive safety and compliance across customer deliveries and reverse logistics, enable new selection, and expand business and transportation models. This Senior Program Manager will develop accurate, relevant, metric-driven analysis to foster continuous improvement and step-function innovation that enhances our internal and external customer experience.

Candidates must be based in one of the corporate locations listed in the requisition.

Candidates must be able to travel at least 25% of the time.

Key job responsibilities

Drive continuous improvement projects across global teams, ensuring Amazon Network Fulfillment (AFN) leads the industry in transportation safety and compliance.
Manage a portfolio of projects aimed at building a best-in-class Dangerous Goods transportation system.
Convert large and complex projects into manageable pieces to deliver iterative improvements while focusing on longer-term, large-scale deliverables.
Build collaborative relationships with leaders across regions, departments, and business units.
Refine existing program processes to more efficiently track and prioritize issues, enabling the team to scale its work.
Anticipate project bottlenecks, manage escalations, make tradeoffs, and balance business needs versus operational or technical constraints.

A day in the life

This role works to transform how Amazon safely transports dangerous goods across its global supply chain. You'll leverage continuous improvement and metric-driven analysis to advance transportation safety, classification systems, and compliant transshipment processes across Amazon Network Fulfillment (AFN) and its transportation partners. You'll define program strategy with business owners, build relationships across regions and business units, and communicate regularly with senior leadership on project risks, escalations, and tradeoffs as a subject matter expert in dangerous goods transportation.

About The Team

The Dangerous Goods team ensures the safety of our Customers, associates and carrier partners by delivering innovative solutions to ensure dangerous goods compliance, redefining industry best practices and standards, and safely enabling an ever-changing borderless business model.

Basic Qualifications

Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level

5+ years of program or project management experience

Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent

jobs.title: Senior Production Security Manager, EU/AF, Studios Protective Services
jobs.description:
Description

Are you a strategic security leader ready to define and scale production security standards across two continents? Amazon MGM Studios is seeking a Senior Production Security Regional Manager for Europe and Africa who combines deep expertise in physical risk management, risk forecasting, and risk mitigation with the strategic vision to transform how we protect global film and television productions.

This role requires someone who operates with minimal governance, sets vision for strategically important initiatives, and works across multiple organizations to own programs and complex solution strategies that meet executive scrutiny. You will apply deep understanding of physical risk management, risk forecasting, and mitigation methodologies to production security—designing scalable frameworks, engaging internal and external stakeholders, and driving continuous improvement of our security posture across Europe and Africa.

The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in security risk management roles, with expertise that spans multiple complex environments and the ability to translate complex regulatory and industry requirements into actionable production security strategies. You must be able to advise Directors and VPs, serve as a tie-breaker on critical security decisions, and create collaborative solutions with regulators, law enforcement, and industry bodies that elevate our security standards.

The Senior Production Security Regional Manager defines and scales professional security services across Amazon MGM Studios productions throughout Europe and Africa. Working strategically across organizations, you will own end-to-end physical risk management programs, develop comprehensive risk forecasting frameworks, and create innovative methodologies for physical asset protection that satisfy demanding operational and stakeholder requirements.

Your work is strategic in nature. You handle significantly complex problems, decisions, and escalations—designing, testing, and inspecting scalable solutions that align teams and organizations towards simple, coherent approaches. You apply expertise across multiple physical risk domains and types of complex production environments, creating cross-organizational structures and mechanisms that drive efficiency and consistency.

You serve as the subject matter expert on production security for the region, advising senior studio leadership (Directors and VPs) on proactive risk forecasting and mitigation strategies. You reduce complexity by creating collaborative solutions with regional regulators, law enforcement agencies, and industry bodies. Your judgment serves as the tie-breaker on decisions for how to respond to emerging threats, security escalations, and complex risk scenarios affecting production operations.

Key job responsibilities

Own programs and complex solution strategies across organizations that meet executive scrutiny, advising Directors and VPs on physical risk management and mitigation strategies.
Build consensus and secure commitments across Amazon MGM Studios, Amazon Security, legal, and regional production teams to drive unified security approaches.
Influence external industry and regulatory leaders through force-multiplication—shaping entertainment security norms, standards, and best practices across Europe and Africa.

Execution and Expertise

Design, test, and inspect scalable risk management frameworks for production environments, handling significantly complex problems and escalations
Apply deep expertise across multiple physical risk domains (threat assessment, venue and location security, personnel protection, asset security) to create unified production security standards
Develop and implement comprehensive threat assessment and risk forecasting methodologies tailored to production environments across diverse European and African jurisdictions
Define business strategy for regional production security, establishing new operational models and risk mitigation standards that account for varying threat landscapes
Apply deep understanding of context, capabilities, and opportunities to reduce complexity—creating collaborative solutions with regulators, law enforcement, and industry partners
Serve as tie-breaker on critical security decisions affecting production operations, balancing creative enablement with compliance obligations
Drive impact across 2-3 production security domains (physical risk management, threat forecasting, asset and personnel protection) and multiple regions
Synthesize insights across security, business, operational, and stakeholder domains to drive proactive adaptations to the production security program
Align teams and organizations towards simple, coherent approaches to production security—creating and optimizing cross-organizational structures and mechanisms
Transform vendor management by defining new performance standards, governance models, and risk mitigation frameworks that reset industry expectations
Develop comprehensive metrics, reporting systems, and decision-support documentation for production security programs
Create strategic communication frameworks that enable proactive risk management and informed decision-making at the executive level

A day in the life

Every day presents unique strategic challenges when securing Studio productions across Europe and Africa, requiring innovative approaches to adapt risk management frameworks as productions evolve. As a Senior Production Security Regional Manager, you will shape how we anticipate and respond to dynamic changes driven by creative direction, competing business priorities, shifting threat landscapes, and evolving global conditions.

This field-based leadership role requires you to build and influence a complex network of relationships spanning Studios and Production executives, regional security partners, law enforcement agencies, regulatory bodies, and Amazon intelligence teams. You develop comprehensive risk forecasting and mitigation strategies that protect Studios’ people, assets, and brand reputation while satisfying diverse compliance obligations.

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Production Security is an elite global network of security and risk strategists aligned with Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios’ strategic priorities worldwide. Working at the intersection of creative vision and security excellence, our team develops innovative approaches to anticipate and address complex production risks across diverse international environments. We leverage multi-source intelligence and our trusted global partner ecosystem to create proactive security solutions that support filmmakers’ creative ambitions while ensuring the safety of our people, protection of our assets, and preservation of our brand. Through strategic risk assessment, deep industry expertise, and strong partnerships with production teams, law enforcement, and security vendors, we enable creative excellence by providing scalable security frameworks that adapt to the dynamic nature of global production environments.

Basic Qualifications

Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Extensive progressive experience and expertise in security operations, physical risk management, or security program leadership, with demonstrated expertise in designing and executing security programs in complex, multi-jurisdictional environments.
Bachelor’s degree in Security Management, Criminal Justice, International Relations, Emergency Management, or equivalent fields
Demonstrated experience developing and implementing risk management frameworks, risk forecasting methodologies, or threat mitigation programs across multiple countries or regions
Proven ability to advise senior leaders (Director/VP level) and influence organizational strategy on risk management matters
Experience engaging with external partners, law enforcement agencies, or industry bodies on physical risk management and mitigation
Extensive experience leading risk assessment and mitigation programs in dynamic, high-profile environments

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with multiple risk domains (e.g., physical security, threat forecasting, personnel protection, content/asset security) applied across diverse production environments
Proven track record of developing innovative security frameworks that have been adopted across organizations or set industry benchmarks
Experience managing security programs for high-profile entertainment operations or complex business environments
Demonstrated success building and managing networks of external partners including regulators, law enforcement, and industry working groups
History of thought leadership in entertainment security, risk forecasting, physical security strategy

jobs.description:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Peraton is hiring a Security Manager.
The qualified candidate will provide security leadership across the contract, including security policy, procedures, planning, evaluation, technology, compliance, incident management, vulnerability management, and GRC. The Security Director coordinates through the Technical Director.

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. jobs.description:
Description

POSITION DESCRIPTION:
The 340B Program Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day administration, compliance monitoring, and data audit activities of the organization's 340B Drug Pricing Program. This dual-scope role oversees compliance across both in-house clinical dispensing environments and our external contract pharmacy network, including dedicated channels with WellPartner, Walgreens and Accredo. The Analyst serves as the primary data custodian, utilizing the Intergy EHR platform alongside the third-party administrator (TPA) software to perform regular audits, reconcile inventory, prevent duplicate discounts, and ensure ongoing adherence to Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) guidelines. Adheres to Corporate Compliance program, by reporting improper or unethical conduct, violation of applicable laws, regulations or program requirements.

Detailed Duties And Responsibilities

Data Auditing & Compliance Management

Intergy & WellPartner Audits: Conduct routine audits of 340B claims by cross-referencing patient clinical data from Intergy EHR with encounter records processed via the WellPartner TPA platform.
Contract Pharmacy Oversight: Monitor, review, and validate qualified 340B prescriptions flowing through external contract pharmacy partners, specifically focusing on specialized Walgreens and Accredo data streams.
In-House Dispensing Monitoring: Track internal clinical encounters and inventory to verify accurate identification of 340B-eligible treatments dispensed within in-house clinics.
Compliance Enforcement: Actively identify and flag potential diversion or duplicate discount violations (specifically regarding Medicaid managed care and fee-for-service claims) prior to regular submissions.

Inventory Control & TPA Optimization

Inventory Reconciliation: Reconcile physical inventory and virtual drug replenishment counters across all internal and contract pharmacy accounts.
System Maintenance: Maintain, update, and test clinical data filters, provider files, and location maps within WellPartner and Intergy to minimize script capture exceptions and optimization gaps.
Accumulation Monitoring: Track WAC and 340B accumulation accounts to ensure clean ordering practices and prevent cross-contamination of drug stocks.

Reporting, Audits & Collaboration

Reporting: Compile, structure, and deliver regular performance metrics and compliance scorecards to the 340B Compliance Administrator and C-Suite.
Audit Preparation: Aggregate and package verifiable historical data logs to support internal reviews and formal HRSA or manufacturer compliance audits.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with internal IT, clinical teams, and account contacts at WellPartner, Walgreens, and Accredo to resolve technical data disparities or workflow blocks.

Requirements

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

Good interpersonal skills.
Ability to conduct oneself professionally.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Advanced capabilities in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, data cleaning formulas) to manage large data extracts from multiple vendors.
Hands-on experience navigating the Intergy EHR system or similar electronic health record platforms for auditing clinical eligibility.
Strong attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies and trends.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established deadlines.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial, operational, and compliance information.
Demonstrate a commitment to ongoing professional development and maintaining current knowledge of 340B regulations, industry best practices, and emerging technologies.

Training And Experience

Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Information Technology, Finance, Business, or a closely related field preferred.
Current Pharmacy Technician Certification (CPhT) or equivalent clinical/administrative licensure is highly advantageous.
Minimum of 1–2 years of direct experience analyzing or handling 340B program data, hospital pharmacy purchasing, or healthcare data compliance operations.

Senior Data Analyst

About Tillster

Headquartered in the USA, Tillster is the global leader in digital ordering and customer engagement solutions. For over a decade we have developed revolutionary self-service, ordering and payments solutions – for mobile, tablet, online, kiosk, call center, and more – creating personalized interactions based on consumer preferences, language, and currency. Our platform is compatible with 15+ unique POS systems, representing over 90% coverage in multi-unit restaurants. We offer one platform: one scalable, enterprise class solution – to create world-class digital engagement solutions. Our mission and passion are one in the same: Empower restaurants and consumers to engage and transact anywhere, anytime, and from any device - one consumer at a time, one order at a time, billions of times over. In doing so, together we are transforming e-commerce in restaurants and making the till grow for Tillster and our customers.

Are you a passionate data analytics with a knack for data?

Job Duties

Analytics & Insight Delivery

Own the end-to-end delivery of complex analytical initiatives — from framing the business question and scoping the analysis through execution, presentation, and follow-through on stakeholder action. Do not wait to be asked; proactively surface KPI trends, anomalies, opportunities, and risks before stakeholders encounter them.
Support ad-hoc analysis for Tillster customers, executives, and internal stakeholders — going beyond data retrieval to provide interpretive framing and actionable recommendations with a clear point of view.
Operate as a trusted analytics advisor to Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering, Account Management, and Support/Operations. Challenge assumptions in business requests where data tells a different story. Translate complex findings into decision-relevant narratives.
Design and support A/B test experiments with statistically valid methodology — including hypothesis definition, sample sizing, success and guardrail metric selection, and results analysis. Communicate findings clearly to Product and Marketing stakeholders.

Google Analytics & Data Collection

Act as the team's primary Google Analytics subject matter expert. Own GA4 reporting, custom dimensions and metrics design, tracking plan validation, and GA-to-warehouse integration. Advise on tagging strategy for new product features and platform launches in partnership with the Lead MarTech Solutions Architect.
BI Development & Semantic Layer
Design, build, and maintain high-performing Explores and dashboards in Looker for business stakeholders including Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering, Account Management, and Support/Operations — owning deliverables end-to-end with minimal re-work.
Develop LookML for owned domains to a high quality standard — including complex dimensions, measures, derived tables, and Explore configurations. Ensure all LookML is documented, tested, and consistent with organisation-wide semantic layer standards.
Ensure metric definitions in owned domains are canonical, unambiguous, and consistent with the definitions governed by the Analytics Engineering team. Flag and resolve discrepancies between business intent and semantic layer implementation.
Expand self-service analytics capabilities — enabling non-technical users across Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to answer their own questions independently, reducing ad-hoc request volume to the team. Target coverage across ≥2 new business units per half-year.
Proactively maintain the accuracy and consistency of production Explores and dashboards as underlying data warehouse structures change. Identify discrepancies before stakeholders encounter them.

Data Quality & Platform Collaboration

Own the accuracy and freshness of all data products in scope. Proactively identify and investigate data quality issues — with root-cause evidence — and partner with Analytics Engineers and Data Engineers to resolve upstream problems promptly.
Write high-quality, performant SQL — including complex window functions and CTEs — and collaborate with Data Engineers on query optimisation, compute cost efficiency, and derived table design for owned analytical workloads.
Collaborate with Analytics Engineers on LookML architecture and semantic layer design for owned domains — providing analytical requirements that inform model design and validating that data models correctly reflect business logic.
Partner with the Senior BI & AI Analyst on customer analytics definitions for segmentation, LTV, and churn use cases. Consume ML model outputs from the Data Science team and surface them accurately in dashboards and analytical narratives.
Understand the structure of data pipelines feeding owned dashboards sufficiently to diagnose data freshness and quality issues, escalate to the correct team, and communicate resolution timelines to stakeholders.

Standards, Mentorship & Team Development

Own coding standards and analytical best practices for the team — including SQL style guides, LookML conventions, documentation requirements, and PR review processes. Conduct structured code reviews that are substantive, consistent, and designed to build capability in Junior Analysts.
Mentor Junior Data Analysts through paired analysis, direct feedback, and structured review. Track improvement over time. Escalate development needs or blockers to the Manager.
Build and contribute reusable assets to shared team libraries — including SQL query patterns, LookML components, analysis frameworks, and documentation templates — reducing time-to-delivery for the entire team, not just own work.
Contribute to at least one standards update, governance policy, or best-practice guide per year.

AI-Augmented Analytics & Self-Serve Agent Development

Apply LLM and AI tools (Gemini, GPT-4, Cortex Analyst, or equivalent) hands-on to accelerate analytics workflows — including automated insight narration, anomaly detection and explanation, and AI-assisted dashboard annotation. Practical delivered experience required; theoretical familiarity is not sufficient.
Design and build self-serve analytics agents that enable non-technical stakeholders in Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Account Management to query data and surface insights in natural language — without raising tickets or requiring analyst intervention. Own the full lifecycle from prompt design through output validation and iteration.
Configure Cortex Analyst or equivalent AI-assisted BI platforms to extend self-service beyond traditional dashboard interaction — including semantic model templates and YAML definitions that produce accurate, governed responses to unstructured business questions.
Define quality standards for AI-generated analytical outputs — including accuracy validation, hallucination detection, and a review process before AI-generated insights are shared externally or with executives.
Prototype and propose AI tooling that reduces repetitive analytical work for the team. Present prototypes to the Manager with a clear build-vs-buy recommendation and documented lessons learned that contribute to the team's shared AI analytics playbook.

Skills Required With Years Of Experience

Core Technical Skills (5-7 years total experience)

SQL & Data Analysis
- 4-5 years

Advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs, query optimization)
Complex analytical queries and performance tuning

Business Intelligence Tools
- 3-4 years

Looker expert (LookML development, Explores, dashboards)
Data visualization and self-service analytics design

Google Analytics
- 2-3 years

GA4 implementation, configuration, and reporting
Tracking strategy and warehouse integration

Python/Programming
- 1-2 years (preferred)

Data manipulation and automation
Version control (Git) and code review

Statistical & Analytical Skills (3-5 Years)

A/B Testing & Experimentation
- 2-3 years

Experimental design and statistical testing
Hypothesis formulation and results interpretation

Statistical Analysis
- 3-4 years

Descriptive and inferential statistics
Trend analysis and anomaly detection

AI & Emerging Technologies (1-2 years)

AI-Augmented Analytics
- 1-2 years

Hands-on LLM usage (GPT-4, Gemini, Cortex Analyst)
AI agent development and prompt engineering
AI output validation and quality standards

Business & Communication Skills (4-6 Years)

Stakeholder Management
- 4-5 years

Cross-functional collaboration (Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering)
Executive communication and presentation
Trusted advisor relationships

Business Analytics
- 3-4 years

Customer analytics (segmentation, LTV, churn)
KPI development and metric definition
Translating business questions to analytical frameworks

Leadership & Mentorship (2-3 years)

Team Leadership
- 2-3 years

Mentoring junior analysts
Code review and standards enforcement
Building team best practices and documentation

Project Management
- 3-4 years

End-to-end analytical project ownership
Managing multiple concurrent initiatives
Proactive insight delivery

Thriving at Tillster

As a member of Tillster, you will embody our core values:

Put Customers First: Prioritize the needs and satisfaction of our customers in all decisions and actions appropriate to Tillster’s stage of development, resources, and stated goals.
Collaborate: Work together effectively, leveraging diverse perspectives to achieve common goals.

Be Passionate and Have Fun: Bring enthusiasm to your work and enjoy the journey.

Additional health benefits include Healthcare and Dependent Care reimbursement programs, Employee Assistance Program (“EAP”) and Optum Care 24-hour confidential medical counseling services.

Support ad-hoc analysis for Tillster customers, executives, and internal stakeholders — going beyond data retrieval to provide interpretive framing and actionable recommendations with a clear point of view.
Operate as a trusted analytics advisor to Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering, Account Management, and Support/Operations. Challenge assumptions in business requests where data tells a different story. Translate complex findings into decision-relevant narratives.
Design and support A/B test experiments with statistically valid methodology — including hypothesis definition, sample sizing, success and guardrail metric selection, and results analysis. Communicate findings clearly to Product and Marketing stakeholders.

Google Analytics & Data Collection

Act as the team's primary Google Analytics subject matter expert. Own GA4 reporting, custom dimensions and metrics design, tracking plan validation, and GA-to-warehouse integration. Advise on tagging strategy for new product features and platform launches in partnership with the Lead MarTech Solutions Architect.
BI Development & Semantic Layer
Design, build, and maintain high-performing Explores and dashboards in Looker for business stakeholders including Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering, Account Management, and Support/Operations — owning deliverables end-to-end with minimal re-work.
Develop LookML for owned domains to a high quality standard — including complex dimensions, measures, derived tables, and Explore configurations. Ensure all LookML is documented, tested, and consistent with organisation-wide semantic layer standards.
Ensure metric definitions in owned domains are canonical, unambiguous, and consistent with the definitions governed by the Analytics Engineering team. Flag and resolve discrepancies between business intent and semantic layer implementation.
Expand self-service analytics capabilities — enabling non-technical users across Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to answer their own questions independently, reducing ad-hoc request volume to the team. Target coverage across ≥2 new business units per half-year.
Proactively maintain the accuracy and consistency of production Explores and dashboards as underlying data warehouse structures change. Identify discrepancies before stakeholders encounter them.

Data Quality & Platform Collaboration

Own the accuracy and freshness of all data products in scope. Proactively identify and investigate data quality issues — with root-cause evidence — and partner with Analytics Engineers and Data Engineers to resolve upstream problems promptly.
Write high-quality, performant SQL — including complex window functions and CTEs — and collaborate with Data Engineers on query optimisation, compute cost efficiency, and derived table design for owned analytical workloads.
Collaborate with Analytics Engineers on LookML architecture and semantic layer design for owned domains — providing analytical requirements that inform model design and validating that data models correctly reflect business logic.
Partner with the Senior BI & AI Analyst on customer analytics definitions for segmentation, LTV, and churn use cases. Consume ML model outputs from the Data Science team and surface them accurately in dashboards and analytical narratives.
Understand the structure of data pipelines feeding owned dashboards sufficiently to diagnose data freshness and quality issues, escalate to the correct team, and communicate resolution timelines to stakeholders.

Standards, Mentorship & Team Development

Own coding standards and analytical best practices for the team — including SQL style guides, LookML conventions, documentation requirements, and PR review processes. Conduct structured code reviews that are substantive, consistent, and designed to build capability in Junior Analysts.
Mentor Junior Data Analysts through paired analysis, direct feedback, and structured review. Track improvement over time. Escalate development needs or blockers to the Manager.
Build and contribute reusable assets to shared team libraries — including SQL query patterns, LookML components, analysis frameworks, and documentation templates — reducing time-to-delivery for the entire team, not just own work.
Contribute to at least one standards update, governance policy, or best-practice guide per year.

AI-Augmented Analytics & Self-Serve Agent Development

Apply LLM and AI tools (Gemini, GPT-4, Cortex Analyst, or equivalent) hands-on to accelerate analytics workflows — including automated insight narration, anomaly detection and explanation, and AI-assisted dashboard annotation. Practical delivered experience required; theoretical familiarity is not sufficient.
Design and build self-serve analytics agents that enable non-technical stakeholders in Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Account Management to query data and surface insights in natural language — without raising tickets or requiring analyst intervention. Own the full lifecycle from prompt design through output validation and iteration.
Configure Cortex Analyst or equivalent AI-assisted BI platforms to extend self-service beyond traditional dashboard interaction — including semantic model templates and YAML definitions that produce accurate, governed responses to unstructured business questions.
Define quality standards for AI-generated analytical outputs — including accuracy validation, hallucination detection, and a review process before AI-generated insights are shared externally or with executives.
Prototype and propose AI tooling that reduces repetitive analytical work for the team. Present prototypes to the Manager with a clear build-vs-buy recommendation and documented lessons learned that contribute to the team's shared AI analytics playbook.

: Supply Chain Data Analyst

Team
: Supply Planning

: Individual Contributor, P3

: 2-5+

Overview

The Supply Chain Data Analyst plays a key role in supporting global supply planning decision-making through data, reporting, and process improvement initiatives. This role partners with the supply planning team to develop scalable reporting solutions, deliver actionable analysis, and improve the quality and accessibility of supply chain data.

This position is highly project-based and will contribute to initiatives that span inventory health, supply planning, ERP processes, reporting automation, KPI development, and business intelligence. The ideal candidate is technically curious, analytically rigorous, and capable of independently solving ambiguous business problems.

What You'll Do

Analytic and Reporting Duties

Design, build, and maintain Tableau dashboards and reporting solutions for Supply Planning and other Supply Chain teams.
Develop and maintain SQL-based reporting layers to support operational and strategic decision-making.
Partner with business stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into scalable data solutions.
Conduct ad hoc analysis related to inventory, supply planning, fulfillment, and product availability.
Validate data quality and investigate discrepancies across reporting systems.

Data & Process Improvement

Assist in developing and maintaining data models and reporting assets using Snowflake.
Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and improve business processes through analytics.
Document business logic, KPI definitions, and data lineage to improve reporting transparency and consistency.
Support testing and validation of new reporting enhancements and data products.
Contribute to cross-functional initiatives involving ERP processes, planning systems, and analytics tools.

Business Partnership

Collaborate closely with Supply Planning team to understand business challenges and provide data-driven recommendations.
Communicate analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Support prioritization and execution of analytics projects aligned to supply chain objectives.
Serve as a trusted partner to stakeholders by balancing business context with analytical rigor.

Problem Solver: You enjoy tackling complex and ambiguous problems, breaking them into manageable components, and identifying practical solutions.
Curious: You naturally ask "why" and are motivated to understand how systems, processes, and data connect.
Self-Sufficient: You can independently research, troubleshoot, and work through challenges while knowing when to ask for support.
Collaborative: You enjoy partnering with stakeholders across business and technical teams and can build strong working relationships.
Communicator: You can clearly explain analytical findings, technical concepts, and business impacts to diverse audiences.
Detail Oriented: You care deeply about data quality, accuracy, and creating solutions that stakeholders can trust.
Continuous Learner: You are excited to expand your knowledge of supply chain operations, analytics, and technology platforms.

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Operations, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.

Advanced SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
Experience developing dashboards and visualizations using Tableau.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
Experience analyzing large datasets and translating findings into business recommendations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Experience using Snowflake.
Experience with dbt or modern data transformation tools.
Experience supporting supply chain, inventory, planning, operations, or ERP processes.
Familiarity with Python, Power Query, or additional analytics tools.
Experience gathering business requirements and supporting cross-functional projects.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, RBS : Cost to Serve
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Retail Business Services (RBS) accelerates Amazon's growth by improving customer and Selling Partner (SP) experiences, while optimizing costs across Stores WW. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon's systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high-quality customer and selling-partner experience.

Cost to Serve (CtS) is a specialized organization within RBS focused on improving Amazon's per-unit economics across the global supply chain. CtS operates on two pillars: defect identification and defect elimination, and partners with WW Operations, Finance, Returns, Concessions, and abuse-related programs to uncover true cost drivers and remove them systematically. The team builds mechanisms that improve cost predictability, strengthen upstream defect visibility, and enable consistent governance across high-impact cost categories, contributing directly to improved Free Cash Flow and scalable business growth.

Are you passionate about building AI-powered cost intelligence solutions at scale? Amazon's RBS CtS organization is looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead our charter for identification of emerging cost trends, which serves as the first step in the journey of Defect Identification and contributes to the organization’s defect elimination work. This role serves as the primary business POC, engaging with RBS, Retail category, FBA and Finance teams in managing two projects (i) Project Strata, a layered analytical product built on a "peel the layers" philosophy that gives RBS and Stores leadership a unified, one-stop view of how Cost to Serve is trending — decomposing headline P&L costs into granular operational drivers and identifying cost opportunities through benchmarking between different time periods, MPs, channels and business lines. (ii) Defining and setting up P0 output and input metrics for RBS's UDE program. This role also serves as the primary POC to our tech partners in building and scaling above two projects and guides a team of Business Analysts who co-develop and validate the MLP and scaled product's outputs.

This leader will define requirements, own the working backward plan and oversee the daily mechanisms that connect business expertise to technical development. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable managing technical product delivery and presenting program health to Director-level leadership, with the judgment to navigate ambiguity in a fast-moving, high-visibility space.

Why You’ll Love This Role

High Impact at Scale: You'll lead identification of emerging cost trends and drive investment by the Org in right cost areas.
Build with Tech: Serve as the key business voice shaping an AI-powered platform from the ground up, defining what good looks like and ensuring the tool meets the bar for downstream adoption.
Leadership Visibility: Own updates to senior leaders on key organizational priorities, with direct influence on how the organization invests in automation long-term.

Key job responsibilities

Business/Tech Partnership & Requirements Definition: Serve as the primary business counterpart to the analytics and tech teams.
Working Backward Planning: Own the milestone delivery plan for above two projects. Identify risks early, adjust plans proactively, and maintain credible path-to-green narratives for leadership.
BA Team Oversight: Manage the Business Analysts who develop MLP of the products. Iteratively capture feedbacks from Stores leaders and ensure the feedback mechanism runs smoothly, quality standards are maintained, and BAs are effectively translating domain expertise into product development.
Quality & Trade-off Decisions: Hold a high bar on output quality. When design or quality blockers arise, make trade-off decisions that balance speed, accuracy, and adoption — escalating to senior leaders for significant calls.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of program or project management experience
5+ years of managing stakeholders in cross-functional project experience
Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications

2+ years of leading large complex programs experience
Master's degree, or MBA in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field

jobs.description:
Since 1973, East West Bank has served as a pathway to success. With over 110 locations across the U.S. and Asia, we are the premier financial bridge between the East and West. Our teams of experienced, multi-cultural professionals help guide businesses and community members on both sides of the Pacific looking to explore new markets and create new opportunities, and our sustained growth and expertise in industries like real estate, entertainment and media, private equity and venture capital, and high-tech help build sustainable businesses and expand our associates’ potential for career advancement.

Headquartered in California, East West Bank (Nasdaq: EWBC) is a top-performing commercial bank with a strong foundation, an enterprising spirit and a commitment to absolute integrity. East West Bank gives people the confidence to reach further.

East West Bank is seeking a hands-on Director level – Senior Business Analyst to lead the design and delivery of scalable, AI-enabled business solutions across the bank’s core domain capabilities, including Payments, Foreign Exchange, Commercial & Corporate Banking, and Digital Banking. This role owns requirements, process architecture, and outcome delivery – partnering across business, technology, risk, compliance, and operations in an agile, iterative model. The position sits within East West Bank’s Enterprise AI Strategy & Transformation organization and is central to the bank’s agenda of modernizing operational workflows, integrating systems, and accelerating responsible AI adoption.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end business analysis and solution design across payments, FX, commercial banking, and digital channel workflows – spanning process, data, integration, and application layers.
Translate ambiguous business needs into structured process models, use cases, user stories, functional specifications, and data flow maps that are engineering-ready and audit-traceable.
Design AI-enabled business solutions – including intelligent automation, LLM-assisted workflows, and decision-support tools – with governance, explainability, and human-in-the-loop controls built in from inception.
Drive rapid prototyping and iterative use case discovery with business stakeholders using low-code tools, wireframing platforms, and AI frameworks to validate concepts before full build commitment.
Own integration and API-enabled workflow design across core banking systems, payment rails, FX engines, CRM, and digital channels, collaborating with enterprise architects and engineering leads.
Lead agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and outcome-based prioritization, ensuring requirements are delivery-ready and value-linked at all times.
Identify and lead process automation opportunities across banking operations – including straight-through processing, exception handling, reconciliation, client onboarding, and reporting workflows.
Embed risk, compliance, and audit controls into solution designs from inception, partnering with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Audit as integral design partners.
Define and track outcome-based KPIs, value realization benchmarks, and executive reporting for all transformation initiatives.

Required Qualifications

8+ years of hands-on experience in process design, application and product design, or workflow transformation within financial services, with strong domain concentration in two or more of: Payments (SWIFT, ACH, RTP, FedNow), FX transaction lifecycle, Commercial or Corporate Banking, or Digital Banking platforms.
Demonstrated experience designing AI-enabled business solutions – including intelligent automation, GenAI or LLM workflows, and decision-support systems – within enterprise or regulated financial services environments.
Strong proficiency in structured business analysis methodologies: BPMN process modeling, use case design, user story development, functional specification writing, and data flow mapping.
Proven agile delivery experience including sprint facilitation, backlog ownership, iterative prototyping, and outcome-based prioritization in cross-functional product or transformation team environments.
API and integration literacy: able to design and document REST API-enabled workflow architectures, system integration patterns, and data exchange specifications in collaboration with engineering and architecture teams.
Deep understanding of banking operational workflows, core banking systems, payment rails, FX transaction lifecycles, and digital banking platforms.
Familiarity with enterprise banking technology vendors including FIS, Fiserv, Temenos, Thought Machine, or equivalent platforms preferred.
Strong understanding of regulatory, risk, compliance, and audit expectations within financial services, with the ability to embed governance requirements into solution designs from the outset.
Excellent executive communication and cross-functional stakeholder management skills; ability to present complex solution designs and delivery status clearly to C-suite audiences.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, Finance, or related discipline required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Modern Tools, Technologies & Techniques

Candidates are expected to bring working fluency across a modern, outcome-oriented delivery toolkit spanning the following areas:
Analysis & Process Design:
Lucidchart, Miro, or Visio for BPMN process modeling; Confluence for living documentation and requirements management; JIRA for agile backlog and sprint delivery tracking.
Rapid Prototyping:
Figma or Balsamiq for UI and UX wireframing; Retool or Appsmith for low-code functional prototype development; Miro or FigJam for collaborative design workshop facilitation.
AI & GenAI Design:
Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, or AWS Bedrock for LLM-assisted workflow design; LangChain or LlamaIndex for RAG architecture pattern design; AI observability tools such as Arize or Fiddler to validate and monitor AI-enabled solutions.
Integration & API Design:
Postman or Swagger/OpenAPI for API specification and integration documentation; MuleSoft or Azure API Management for enterprise integration pattern design; Kafka or Azure Event Hub for event-driven, real-time payment workflow design.
Data & Analytics:
Snowflake, Databricks, or Azure Synapse for data platform literacy; Power BI or Tableau for operational dashboard design and KPI tracking; SQL proficiency for data validation and requirements verification.
Agile Delivery:
SAFe or Scrum delivery frameworks; Design Thinking facilitation for stakeholder discovery and problem framing; ProductBoard or Aha! for outcome-based roadmapping and initiative prioritization.

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

Compensation

The base pay range for this position is USD $130,000.00/Yr. - USD $225,000.00/Yr. Exact offers will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

jobs.title: Revenue Accounting Project Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Function Health is the AI operating system for health, designed to empower people to live 100 healthy years. We are redefining how individuals understand, measure, and improve their health by moving beyond the limitations of traditional care and enabling comprehensive, continuous insight into human biology. Function has been recognized as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, and is venture-backed by Redpoint and other leading venture firms. Over half a million members have joined Function to take control of their health.

Through comprehensive lab testing, MRI and CT imaging, longitudinal data, and guidance from AI and clinical teams, Function gives members a complete and continuous view of their health — and the clarity to act on it. Through acquisitions across imaging, mobile phlebotomy, and supplement tracking and optimization, Function is building an integrated health platform that spans the full path from testing to health clarity to daily action.

Function recently announced a $298M Series B and is entering its next chapter of growth. As we scale, the quality and durability of our People systems, data, and insights will directly shape our ability to attract, retain, and support exceptional talent.

We are growing our team and seeking out world-class talent that deeply believes in our mission to positively impact global health, has a relentless bias toward action, and a growth mindset. Function fosters a collaborative and dynamic environment where every day we build the future.

Role

The Revenue Accounting Project Manager
will help build and standardize how Function Health's revenue accounting function operates — the processes it runs on and the systems that support them — without performing the close itself. This role sits at the intersection of accounting, process design, and cross-functional execution: you'll understand accounting treatment well enough to shape sound requirements and standards, and you'll project-manage the work needed to get there, in service of a team that owns the close.

You'll work across multiple revenue streams, each with its own systems, maturity level, and open questions. You'll support the team's initiative roadmap by surfacing where a process or control needs attention, then take ownership of sequencing, scoping, and driving that work to a documented, repeatable outcome. That often involves systems and data, but just as often it's about establishing how something should work as a matter of process, independent of any one tool. The ideal candidate has an accounting background and can speak the language fluently, but is energized by building the structure around accounting rather than executing the close itself. You're naturally curious, comfortable digging into ambiguity to find the root cause of a problem, and able to independently manage a project from open questions to a finished, standardized process.

You will report to the Senior Revenue Accounting Manager,
and operate with a high degree of autonomy on your workstreams while receiving direction on priorities and judgment calls. This is a strong fit for someone who wants ownership over how the function's processes and initiatives take shape — bringing forward what they're noticing, flagging what doesn't make sense, and driving cross-functional projects to completion with minimal oversight once scoped.

Key Responsibilities

Support the Senior Manager in shaping the accounting initiative roadmap — surfacing process gaps, risks, and opportunities, then owning the scoping and prioritization of your workstreams once direction is set.
Design and standardize accounting processes and controls across revenue streams — independent of any single system — so operations run consistently and predictably as the business scales.
Own end-to-end project management for revenue accounting initiatives — scoping requirements, sequencing workstreams, tracking open items across stakeholders, and driving projects to completion against a deadline.
Serve as the connective tissue between Accounting and Data/Engineering, Finance, and Product — gathering requirements, resolving ambiguity between teams, and ensuring decisions made in one function are accurately reflected in another.
Translate accounting treatment and technical judgment into system requirements and configuration logic for ERP/revenue recognition systems, partnering with implementation teams and internal engineering resources.
Investigate data quality and process breakdowns by working directly with underlying datasets — tracing issues to root cause rather than reconciling around them, and partnering with Data/Engineering to fix them at the source.
Build and maintain documentation, mapping logic, and handoff materials that convert undocumented or ad hoc knowledge into clear, auditable procedures the accounting team can run against.
Prepare clear, organized documentation and data support for external audit and advisory partners on request, without owning the audit relationship directly.

Qualifications/Skills

7+ years of progressive experience spanning accounting and either project management, business/systems analysis, or accounting operations; Big 4 public accounting experience is strongly preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
Solid understanding of US GAAP and ASC 606 revenue recognition, including application to subscription or service-based revenue models — strong enough to shape sound requirements and standards, even without performing the close.
Demonstrated project management skills — able to independently scope, sequence, and drive a cross-functional initiative to completion.
Experience designing or standardizing operational processes and controls, not just executing within existing ones.
Strong data skills — comfortable working directly in large or imperfect datasets (Excel, SQL, or similar) to investigate issues rather than relying solely on pre-built reports.
Track record of working cross-functionally with non-accounting teams (data, engineering, product, or finance) and translating between accounting requirements and technical or operational execution.
Clear, precise written and verbal communicator, with an ability to document process and judgment calls in a way others can follow without you in the room.

Nice To Have

Experience scoping, configuring, and testing ERP or revenue recognition system implementations (e.g., NetSuite, Rillet, Zuora, or similar platforms) as an accounting stakeholder.
SQL or other data-querying experience sufficient to independently investigate transaction-level data.
CPA certification (or equivalent)
Experience with subscription-based, membership, or consumer health/tech business models.
Hands-on use of AI or automation tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, advanced Excel/Sheets) in accounting or process-improvement workflows.

To be a strong fit, you embody our Core Values

Ruthless Prioritization:
We don’t let perfect get in the way of progress.
We move quickly to drive value, not perfection.
We prioritize what drives impact.
We never compromise on standards of excellence.

Member-First, Always:
We design and deliver like we’re caring for someone we love.
We create calendar, actionable, human experience.
We prioritize responsiveness, peace of mind, and outcomes.
We empower members with truth, clarity, and care.

One Team, Moving Fast:
We are aligned in purpose, prioritization, and speed.
We gather diverse perspectives to make informed decisions.
We clear paths for each other and move fast together.
We communicate clearly and respectfully, rallying around shared goals.

Radical Ownership, Relentless Execution:
We don’t just ship– we own outcomes and drive results.
We act with urgency and precision
We anticipate, initiate, and follow through.
We meet challenges with grit and pragmatism.
We embrace new tech to deliver better outcomes.

Mission Over Ego:
We are ruthlessly aligned to our mission - and leave ego at the door.
We disagree and commit.
We don't tolerate politics or withholding information.
We operate with honesty, transparency, and respect.

Sustained Integrity in Every Detail:
We earn trust by obsessing over accuracy, quality, and clarity in everything we do.
We prioritize clinical precision - data must be right.
We sweat the details because outcomes depend on them.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

We value our team at Function and offer a competitive salary and benefits package, flexible working hours, and a dynamic work environment where creativity and innovation are encouraged. If you are a highly motivated and experienced individual who is passionate about using technology to improve people’s lives, we would love to hear from you.

At Function, we celebrate diversity and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender identity, ancestry, religion, age, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, marital status, Veteran status, or any other occupationally irrelevant criteria.

Join the Function Health team and become a part of our mission to build a healthier future for all. Discover more about us and how we're changing the face of healthcare at Function Health.

Important Notice:
Legitimate communication from the Function Health team will always come from an email address ending in @functionhealth.com. Function Health will never request personal information such as banking details or payment during the hiring process. Please be cautious of communications or job offers that come from other email domains, instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls. If you ever have doubts about the legitimacy of a communication, please reach out to us directly at talent@functionhealth.com.

This role will sit primarily on the job site, with occasional travel to the office for trainings, meetings, etc.

Who are we?

As a Top-10 ENR Contractor, Gilbane is a family-owned business with 45 offices that has been shaping communities since 1870. Consistently recognized as one of the most reputable construction management firms in the country, Gilbane is committed to delivering projects safely and on-time. You will have the opportunity to build schools, labs, hospitals, corporate offices, sports arenas and more!

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Who are you?

You are a coach/leader who leads with an inclusive and empathetic mindset. You provide feedback and guidance to help others excel in their current or future roles. You determine priorities, delegate work, and effectively communicate progress. You establish measures to assess the impact, quality, and timeliness of results while praising successes and sharing lessons learned. You build high performing teams by attracting, engaging, developing, and retaining talented individuals through motivation and discipline to maximize impact on the organization and the individual.

You leverage business insights by understanding industry trends, local market/economic conditions, and Gilbane’s business model to make critical decisions and create competitive advantage. You deploy a strategic mindset when considering solutions to long-term opportunities and risks that may develop in the future.

Your core values match Gilbane’s: Integrity, Caring, Teamwork, Toughmindedness, Dedication to Excellence, Discipline, Loyalty, and Entrepreneurship.

What’s in it for you?

Gilbane offers employees multi-dimensional training opportunities through a number of resources. While managing your responsibilities to the project, you will be able to enroll in trainings through our award-winning Gilbane University to build leadership and technical skills. In addition, you will work with an experienced team on each job site which provides you with opportunity to learn new industry skills every day. You will protect and promote the interests of both Gilbane and the client in all matters as well as demonstrating the personal characteristics of a developing leader.

Responsibilities

Develops the project safety plan with corporate safety and provides jobsite leadership
Develops the project controls and procedures to manage complex project requirements; takes ownership to mitigate high-risk items for contract requirements
Manages project financial forecast, notice provisions, and billings to meet contract requirements; takes corrective actions to address deviations noted in project vitals
Creates and manages a project-specific quality plan aligned with the Owner contract and contract documents and assists with execution
Creates and manages a closeout plan in alignment with the contract documents and assists with execution
Provides leadership in motivating the project team and maintains a positive work environment. This shall include direct supervision of work, project administration, project superintendents, and engineers to establish operational priorities.
Develops the subcontracting strategy; reviews and writes scopes and other deliverables to ensure the integrity of the buyout process
Implements and enforces all aspects of contracts; creates and leads risk mitigation plan; prepares draft contracts, agreements, and purchase orders
Assumes accountability for the enrollment for insurance and bonds and manages the compliance process for trade contractors
Leads the development of the project estimate and manages the project team and estimating team to meet contractual obligations
Leads project constructability and coordination reviews
Creates CPM schedule for large and/or complex projects; accountable for recognizing the potential for schedule impacts and drafting prevention/ mitigation plans
Develops a basic understanding of the local market areas and profiles to create and lead a networking strategy
Collaborates closely with business development to ensure seamless integration with sales strategies including performance metrics on your assigned projects, pursuits, and client deliverables. Actively participates in opportunities to strengthen client, partner, and industry relationships that position Gilbane as the “Builder of Choice”
Responsible for the career development and coaching of team members
Fosters a positive and inclusive work environment to motivate and engage team members
Interprets and translates the organizational strategy, ensuring team understanding of their role in accomplishing strategic goals

Experience/Education

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering or Construction Management
10-12 years of commercial construction project management experience is required, managing projects as the Developer or General Contractor lead
Corporate Interiors, Interior Renovation/Alterations, and Cultural / Institutional construction experience is preferred
Or equivalent combination of education and experience

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strong soft skills, technical and communication skills are critical
Ability to work in a team environment
Knowledge of industry standard project management software, Microsoft Office (preferred)

Salary to be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience of the applicant, as well as the internal equity and alignment with the team.

For New York City, this ranges from $160,000-$210,000 plus benefits and retirement program.

Gilbane offers an excellent total compensation package which includes competitive health and welfare benefits and a generous profit-sharing/401k plan. We invest in our employees’ education and have built Gilbane University into a top training organization in the construction industry.
