We’re seeking a dynamic and experienced Project Manager to join Serco’s Naval Acquisition and Sustainment Operation (NASO). This position is contingent upon your ability to maintain your DoD Secret level clearance.

Serco’s Naval Acquisition and Sustainment Operation is part of our high-performing Maritime, Engineering, Technology, and Sustainment Business Unit which provides critical services to nearly all U.S. Navy surface ships, submarines and craft and is achieving truly impactful outcomes. Lead teams providing technical guidance to Ship's Force relating to work on Hull, Mechanical & Electrical (HM&E) and aviation equipment and systems which interface with combat support systems, and hull support items such as damage control equipment for flooding and fire, climate control/ventilation systems, tank and voids, plenums, etc., habitability improvements, and piping systems. Also encompassed are electrical generation, power and distribution systems including controllers, junction boxes, cabling, and cableways.
Lead the performance of inspections, examinations, analysis, repairs incidental to such and make recommendations in the areas of maintenance planning and/or repair as requested on naval propulsion and auxiliary machinery associated with high pressure steam propulsion plants and U.S. Naval Surface Force Ship propulsion plants and auxiliaries.
Liaison with ship’s reactor department is required prior to accomplishing inspections, testing, and production work
Manage teams performing, assisting, or providing technical guidance on the performance of fault identification and support Ship's Force with physical repairs of the types of naval propulsion and auxiliary and aviation/flight deck equipment/combat systems and systems set forth herein
Responsible for technical support and advice to Ship's Force pertinent to the operation, overhaul, and repair of specific items of, auxiliary machinery, electrical, and hull support and aviation systems as directed by the appropriate technical authority.
Oversee the performance or provide guidance IAW Corrosion Control Assessment and Maintenance Manual (CCAMM) for the Maintenance System Work Package Planning (MSWP) (T-9630-ABMMD-010/all USN hulls) to Ship's Force with training, inspection and reporting of tanks, voids, plenums, bilges, catwalks, pump room decks, and Aqueous Film Forming Foam (AFFF) station decks. Perform or provide technical guidance in support of TYCOM Cableway Improvement Program (CIP) in accordance with NAVSEAINST 9304 series to Ship's Force with training, inspection, repair assistance and reporting.
Develop updated training package to the TYCOM and to the RMCs. Provide formal on-board operator and maintenance training to Ship’s Force.
Develop Formal Work Packages (FWPs) and Controlled Work Packages (CWPs) in accordance with the Joint Fleet Maintenance Manual.
Manage personnel as required to support short-term and long-term contract efforts.
Cultivating positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

An active DoD security clearance is required.
Three years should be closely involved with practical surface ship maintenance, design, operation, and other problems of main propulsion, auxiliary,electrical, and damage control equipment associated with shipboard level maintenance.
Two years direct experience with auxiliary, electrical, and damage control systems and included steam propulsion plants.
Two years direct experience with auxiliary, electrical and damage control systems for U.S. Naval Ships.
Two years of supervisory experience.
Up to 25% of travel for CONUS/OCONUS may be required.

Knowledge of best practice maritime processes and support methodologies to meet Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) requirements.
Ability to lead and manage large teams.
Ability to operate personal computers and have good knowledge and operational abilities with Microsoft Office tools.

jobs.title: General Engineer/Architect (Planning and Program Manager)
jobs.description:
Duties

Summary

This position is located in the Architect of the Capitol (AOC), Office of the Chief Security Officer (OCSO), Deputy Operations, Security Infrastructure Projects Division. The Architect/Engineer (Planning and Program Manager) is responsible for project management development, with emphasis on projects involving security infrastructure or facilities.

Requirements

Qualifications

You must meet the United States Office of Personnel Management's (OPM) qualification requirements (including specialized experience and/or educational requirements) for the advertised position. You must meet all eligibility and qualifications requirements by the closing date of the job announcement. Additional information on the qualification requirements is outlined in the OPM Qualifications Standards Handbook of General Schedule Positions. It is available for your review on the OPM web site at OPM qualification standards For Engineers: http://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/0800/general-engineering-series-0801/ For Architects: http://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/0800/architecture-series-0808/ --AND-- In addition to meeting the basic education requirement for an Engineer or Architect, you resume must clearly demonstrate the required specialized experience as described below. Specialized Experience is experience that has equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position and is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled. To be creditable, an applicant's one full year (52 weeks) of specialized experience must demonstrate the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary for successful job performance. To qualify at the GS-13 level, your resume must clearly demonstrate that you have one full year (52 weeks) of specialized experience comparable in difficulty and responsibility to at least the GS-12 level in the federal service. Examples of qualifying experience include the following types of tasks performed on a regular and recurring basis: Performing design and development, technical reviews, quality control and project management on security infrastructure projects from planning and programming through construction; Providing technical advice and recommendations on construction projects, staff, and resources, including costs, design and contract and development management; and Evaluating studies, plans, design specifications and progress reports for architectural, engineering and construction processes and projects; Serving as a Contracting Officer's Technical Representative (COTR) or equivalent. Collaborating with top level technical representatives of industry, Congressional offices, and others in the development of facilities and long range work plans supporting facilities and infrastructure projects. Providing authoritative interpretations of guidelines and practices used in the design and repair, restoration and alteration of existing facilities; *Professional registration as a planner American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP), Architect, Landscape Architect or Licensed (PE) engineer and Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) accredited professional is highly desired but recommended.*

The mission of the Architect of the Capitol (AOC) is to serve Congress and the Supreme Court, preserve America's Capitol and inspire memorable experiences. The AOC is responsible for the maintenance, operation, development and preservation of 18.4 million square feet of buildings and more than 570 acres of land throughout Capitol Hill. The AOC provides a welcoming and educational environment for millions of visitors through the U.S. Capitol Visitor Center and the US Botanic Garden. Learn more at https://www.aoc.gov/careers. The AOC prides itself on its Core Values of Respect, Integrity, Safety and Empower (RISE).

jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to become Earth's most customer-centric company and to grow in a safe environment for both our customers and our associates. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, dynamic, and passionate people.

The Dangerous Goods (DG) team is looking for a motivated Senior Program Manager with strong regulatory experience, operational knowledge, logistics experience, and a hands-on passion to dive deep into processes that support Amazon's growth in a safe environment for customers, partners, and associates.

Working across procurement, transportation services, delivery experience, returns and re-commerce, technology, storage, legal, public policy, and other relevant internal teams on a global scale, this Senior Program Manager will ensure the safety of our associates and transportation partners by delivering innovative solutions for the safe and compliant transportation of DG, redefining industry best practices and standards, and safely enabling an ever-changing borderless business model.

This Senior Program Manager will plan and execute DG policies, controls, and processes to ensure the safe and compliant transportation of DG across a global supply chain. Working collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders, consultants, and regulators, this role will drive safety and compliance across customer deliveries and reverse logistics, enable new selection, and expand business and transportation models. This Senior Program Manager will develop accurate, relevant, metric-driven analysis to foster continuous improvement and step-function innovation that enhances our internal and external customer experience.

Candidates must be based in one of the corporate locations listed in the requisition.

Candidates must be able to travel at least 25% of the time.

Drive continuous improvement projects across global teams, ensuring Amazon Network Fulfillment (AFN) leads the industry in transportation safety and compliance.
Manage a portfolio of projects aimed at building a best-in-class Dangerous Goods transportation system.
Convert large and complex projects into manageable pieces to deliver iterative improvements while focusing on longer-term, large-scale deliverables.
Build collaborative relationships with leaders across regions, departments, and business units.
Refine existing program processes to more efficiently track and prioritize issues, enabling the team to scale its work.

This role works to transform how Amazon safely transports dangerous goods across its global supply chain. You'll define program strategy with business owners, build relationships across regions and business units, and communicate regularly with senior leadership on project risks, escalations, and tradeoffs as a subject matter expert in dangerous goods transportation.

jobs.description:
Description

The Global Energy, Sustainability, and Automation team is seeking an experienced and highly organized Project Manager to lead the deployment of infrastructure technologies across Amazon's fulfillment and logistics network.

The Tech Deployment team serves as a scalable execution function for infrastructure and technology programs across Amazon's operational facilities. The team partners with engineering, operations, construction, technology teams, vendors, and other stakeholders to deploy solutions spanning electrical infrastructure, HVAC and building systems, controls and automation, metering, sensing and location technologies, and other emerging infrastructure technologies.

In this role, you will manage multiple concurrent deployment programs from planning through field execution, validation, and operational handoff. You will translate technical requirements into executable deployment plans, coordinate vendors and internal stakeholders, manage schedule and execution risks, and establish repeatable processes that enable technologies to scale across a large and geographically distributed portfolio.

The successful candidate will have experience delivering complex technical or infrastructure projects and operating effectively in environments with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and evolving technical requirements. Experience with electrical systems, HVAC, controls and automation, material handling equipment, sensing technologies, or other building and operational infrastructure is preferred.

This role requires a self-starter who can independently manage multiple projects, identify and resolve execution barriers, and influence stakeholders across organizational boundaries. The candidate must also demonstrate the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar technologies and technical requirements sufficiently to lead their successful deployment.

This is a travel-based role. Travel across North America of up to 50% or more may be required depending on project needs.

Key job responsibilities

Manage multiple concurrent technology and infrastructure deployment programs from planning through implementation, validation, and operational handoff.
Develop deployment strategies, project plans, schedules, milestones, and execution mechanisms that enable repeatable deployment across multiple sites.
Translate engineering and technical requirements into executable field deployment plans in partnership with engineering teams, vendors, contractors, and site stakeholders.
Coordinate internal and external stakeholders to ensure projects are executed safely, on schedule, and in accordance with technical requirements.
Manage vendors and contractors, including performance, quality, schedule adherence, execution risks, and corrective actions.
Manage escalations, installation deviations, field constraints, and rework, driving issues through resolution with appropriate technical and business stakeholders.
Analyze deployment and audit data, including vendor KPIs, installation quality, schedule performance, and other execution metrics, to identify systemic issues and opportunities for improvement.
Develop working knowledge of technical systems and facilitate root-cause analysis and issue resolution when deployment challenges arise.
Work across hardware, software, controls, networking, and physical infrastructure interfaces where required to support successful technology integration.
Develop mechanisms, standard work, documentation, and best practices that improve deployment consistency, quality, and scalability.
Provide clear program updates, risk assessments, escalation paths, and recommendations to senior leadership and execution teams.
Use data and metrics to evaluate deployment performance and identify opportunities to improve processes, resources, vendor performance, and execution models.
Build effective partnerships across engineering, operations, construction, procurement, technology teams, and other global stakeholders to support long-term scalability of deployment programs.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
Experience working cross-functionally across several teams both technical and non-technical
Experience in project management including resource planning, managing schedules, reporting project status and prioritizing tasks
3+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
Experience managing and coordinating multiple projects simultaneously

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
3+ years of driving process improvements experience
Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
PMP certificate
Experience building scalable programs and repeatable scalable processes, levering various tools and methods to create scale and efficiency
Experience working with multiple groups of stakeholders
Experience with one or more infrastructure domains such as electrical systems, HVAC, controls and automation, material handling equipment, metering, sensing technologies, networking, or building systems.
Experience operating in a geographically distributed, multi-site environment.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Description

SENIOR PROJECT MANAGER

This position is based out of Multiple Locations.

About ArchKey

ArchKey is one of the nation’s largest privately held specialty trade installation and integrated facility service companies. We are a leader in designing, building and maintaining electrical, technologies and specialty systems. We’re the POWER behind making the improbable possible.

We’re electrifying the nation, energizing the future and bringing communities to life like never before. What we do today shapes the vision of tomorrow. Our work impacts lives long after the building is done. This means we are committed to building in ways that are not just technologically advanced, but sustainable, scalable and equitable by all. We’re not just energizing infrastructure, we’re energizing careers, communities, and the future.

Made up of the brightest minds in the industry, our team is our greatest asset bringing knowledge, skills, and experience to every project.This is more than a call to join us, it’s an invitation to be part of a visionary journey, to grow with us as we scale.

About The Position

Responsible to manage one large project or multiple technology projects of varying sizes and complexities from start to finish, including estimating, contract negotiations, project design, technical direction, quality control, job scheduling, financial oversight, problem resolution, job completion, coordination, communication, client satisfaction activities and other related duties. This position manages a team of project management employees and has responsibility for business development, project budgets, projections and contracts, job solicitation and project negotiations, in alignment with all Company policies, procedures, key objectives and regulations.This position may assist technologies construction projects including but not limited to all types of low voltage systems such as voice/data, video and security systems, audiovisual, nurse call, distributed antenna systems, and fire alarm systems.

Our Ideal Candidate

Puts a strong emphasis on candidate experience.
Can flex and adapt with the growing needs of the business.
Has extensive experience managing technology construction projects.
Can adhere to the travel nature of the role.

Day in the Life

Partners with leadership to provide strategic input to key objectives and decisions affecting the business unit and functional work group. Conducts high-quality business development and job solicitation in the marketplace, in partnership with other Company leaders. Provides ongoing quality reviews and project communication with owners, contractors, designers, subcontractors, engineers, architects, field staff, and other customers or stakeholders, addressing and resolving issues when needed.
Directs all phases and activities of each project to achieve high quality and productivity in the work performed. This includes bidding, budgeting, monitoring projections, and establishing goals and standards of performance. Ensures all jobs or contracts are fulfilled to the customer’s satisfaction, and the Company earns a fair profit. Optimizes efficiency of labor, materials, supplies, equipment, and tools, and ensures all plans and specifications clearly identify project scope and milestones, are shared with the appropriate parties, and adhere to approved budgets. Ensures all safety programs and OSHA requirements are followed.
Communicates directly with subcontractors and designers concerning project costs, staffing, and scheduling. Prepares and manages timely and accurate project documents, estimates, projections, material release schedules, client information, project schedules, purchase orders, monthly invoices, payments, closeout documents, warranties, drawings, maintenance manuals, final billings, change orders, cost codes and other documentation to support construction project work.
Procures materials proactively and coordinated, working with the purchasing team to reduce material price fluctuations. May negotiate with vendors and distributors on availability and pricing of materials, completion of quotes, and other necessary procedure details. Ensures all plans and submittals are thoroughly and accurately reviewed for content and conformance with the construction documents and maintained in the appropriate systems.
others to transfer documentation, schedules, and other information.
Provides day-to-day direction to project foreman and/or superintendent to monitor productivity goals and build teamwork. Partners with appropriate personnel to conduct job site inspections and ensure accurate scope, placement, and conformance with the contract documents and the Company’s project quality assurance standards. Ensures all field personnel have the current materials, tools, plans, schedules, and directions needed for work, and that all changes in budget and scope of work are communicated and documented appropriately.
Provides high-quality hiring, coaching, communications, training, mentoring, and team building to staff and other co-workers as needed. Provides performance feedback regularly. Addresses people's issues as they arise and involves the necessary resources to resolve problems.
Creates and manages an annual financial budget and maintains some level of responsibility for Companywide financials. Stays informed of new and changing Company procedures, policies, materials, technologies, techniques, and practices. Establishes, trains, and maintains policies and processes as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in electrical, project management, construction management, or a related field.
Minimum 5-7 years of project management experience. Extensive project management training and skills. Thorough understanding of the project life cycle.
Experience with computerized estimating systems and software, preferably Accubid. Experience and proficiency using Accubid, Revit, CAD, SKM, AGI, Navisworks, and/or BIM systems may be required for some divisions or business groups.
Trained and proficient in project management tools and techniques, negotiating, budgeting, estimating, costing, contracting, scheduling, pricing, and common code requirements. Strong business analysis and mathematical skills. Show ability to diagnose complex problems with strategic critical thinking skills and detail orientation, and to drive appropriate solutions with self-initiative and sensitivity.
Knowledge of and proficiency with construction methods and materials, costing, power, lighting, systems design, and general industry safety and OSHA standards, procedures, and regulations. Keen understanding of the National Electric Code. Skills to read, interpret and understand financial documents, electrical bids, contracts, plans, drawings, blueprints, and specifications.
Excellent communicator/collaborator, with the ability to clearly and concisely articulate ideas and concepts and the ability to build strong working teams, cultures, and relationships at all levels and with customers, subcontractors, vendors, and other community leaders. Strong business development, documentation, and report preparation skills.
Strong hiring, collaboration, teamwork, and interpersonal skills. Ability to work with and facilitate diverse work teams. Leadership, customer focus, delegation, and decision-making skills. Working knowledge of collective bargaining agreements.

Travel

Travel to project sites is required, which may include temporary relocation for the duration of the project.

Salary Range

$107,000 - $172,000 Annually, based on location, experience and qualifications

Benefits

At ArchKey Solutions, our benefits package includes competitive health insurance options (medical, dental, and vision), a robust 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match, paid time off and holidays, and access to wellness programs. Additionally, we offer professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement, and employee assistance programs to support your growth and well-being. We ensure that our benefits are designed to promote the health, security, and work-life balance of our employees. Additional information is available at Archkey.com. #CA30-1

Legal & Fraud Disclaimer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.Weare an Affirmative Action, Equal Opportunity Employer.

Beware of fraudulent job postings. ArchKey Solutions only communicates through official channels. All official communication will come from an @archkey.com email address and we will never ask for financial information, payments, or personal details outside of the standard hiring process. To confirm the legitimacy of a job, visit our careers page or reach out to a member of our Talent Acquisition team. #M01-10

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

As Senior Project Manager, you will be a part of a leadership team dedicated to directing the day-to-day management of the project. You will create a project plan that outlines the tasks, timelines, and resources required to achieve the project’s goals. Successful candidates will demonstrate a passion for and dedication to getting the job done.

Responsibilities

Lead all activities related to contract administration, change orders, procurement, schedule, and financial reporting
Have thorough knowledge of the company's contracts and understanding of all parties involved
Secure required permits and verify insurance coverage for subcontractors
Facilitate project meetings to successfully coordinate work activity
Lead, train, and develop project team members
Prepare and submit monthly job status reports that outline project priorities and issues
Lead project close-out of project, including turnover of manuals and warranties and preparation of final payment documents for subcontractors
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with counterparts at owner, engineering and design firms
Establish a deadline and monitor the progress of the project
Drive a culture of safety on the project site
Support the company’s acquisition of new work by participating in proposals and presentations
Provide leadership to foster an environment of inclusion and diversity
Proactively identify and develop relationships with industry professionals to generate and win the right work
Take an active role in recruiting top industry talent to join the Clark team. Identify, hire, and retain outstanding people
Exceed our stakeholders’ expectations by anticipating their needs, desires, and goals

Basic Qualifications

Undergraduate or graduate degree in engineering, architecture, construction management, a related discipline, or relevant work experience
7+ years of construction experience required; working for a general contractor on large-scale construction projects is highly preferred
4+ years leading, developing, and motivating teams
Understanding of the strategic, operational, and financial components of a construction project
Ability to make timely and effective decisions
Experience managing projects successfully from start to finish
Skilled at developing and negotiating relationships with owners and trade contractors
Strong work ethic, leadership, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment
Alignment to Clark Standards of Excellence: self-motivated, results oriented, adaptable, team player, accountable, ethical, innovative, resilient, builds relationships, builds people/teams and followership, sets direction and executes

Preferred Qualifications

DBIA and/or LEED Accreditation

The work environment and requirements described below are representative of those necessary for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role.

The Physical Side of the Role:
This is an active, hands-on role. You can expect to be on your feet frequently, navigating active job sites with uneven terrain, stairs, ladders, and hoists. The work is physically demanding and requires a full range of motion, including bending, kneeling, and reaching. You’ll need to be comfortable frequently lifting and carrying materials up to 25 pounds, and occasionally up to 50 pounds. This role requires the ability to communicate effectively, as well as visual acuity for reading plans and inspecting work. The role does include desk time in the office that may require prolonged periods of sitting for tasks like computer work, document review, and meetings.

Your Work Environment:
You’ll spend a significant amount of your time on active construction sites, which means being adaptable to all kinds of weather and moderate to loud noise levels, and comfortable in elevated or confined work areas with moving mechanical equipment and with the fast-paced nature of a project in progress. You will also spend time in a typical office setting with moderate noise levels. Your safety is our top priority, and you'll be expected to follow Clark Construction's safety policies and procedures, and all applicable laws, at all locations.

Our High-Performing Culture:

jobs.description:
Threat Intelligence Analyst (AI Training)

About The Role

We partner with the world's leading AI research teams and labs to build and train cutting-edge AI models. Now, we're looking for experienced threat intelligence professionals to bring real-world adversary knowledge to the frontier of AI development.

Your expertise in tracking campaigns, analyzing TTPs, and communicating threat narratives will directly shape how AI systems understand and reason about cybersecurity threats. This is a rare opportunity to apply your security skills in a high-impact, flexible remote contract role.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

Analyze and classify real-world threat reports, adversary campaigns, and attacker behavior

Apply frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK to assess and contextualize adversary activity

Strong analytical, research, and written communication skills

Familiarity with threat actor tracking, malware analysis, or incident response
Background working with ISACs, government agencies, or security vendors

Work directly on frontier AI systems alongside top research labs
Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule
Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
Apply your real-world security expertise to a genuinely novel and meaningful challenge
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

jobs.description:
About The Role

What if your instinct for how attacks unfold — the lateral movement, the missed detection, the cascading failure — could directly shape how the world's most advanced AI systems understand cybersecurity?

We're looking for experienced offensive and defensive security professionals to analyze real-world attack scenarios, model adversary behavior, and help build the adversarial reasoning data that trains and evaluates cutting-edge AI. This role is about structured threat thinking — not writing exploits.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. If you can map a kill chain, identify where defenses collapse, and explain it clearly, we want to hear from you.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

Analyze attack paths, kill chains, and adversary strategies across realistic, production-grade environments
Identify weaknesses, misconfigurations, and defensive gaps that real threat actors exploit
Review red team scenarios and intrusion narratives for accuracy, depth, and adversarial realism
Generate, label, and validate adversarial reasoning data used to train and evaluate AI systems

Experience with cloud environments, Active Directory, or enterprise network architectures
Background in threat intelligence, incident response, or detection engineering
Prior experience creating or reviewing security training content

Apply your hard-earned security expertise to a domain that's actively shaping the future of AI

What if your security expertise could directly shape how the world's most advanced AI systems defend against attacks, misuse, and adversarial manipulation? We're looking for AI Security Analysts to put frontier AI models under the microscope — probing their limits, identifying vulnerabilities, and helping ensure they remain safe, reliable, and resistant to exploitation.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for security professionals who are curious about how AI systems are built, deployed, and attacked. If you think in threat models and instinctively look for what can go wrong, this work was made for you.

Analyze real-world AI and LLM security scenarios to understand how models behave under adversarial or unexpected conditions

We’re looking for a Technical Program Manager to own complex, time-sensitive data and evaluation programs for frontier AI labs, data vendors, and internal teams. You’ll turn ambiguous technical asks into executable programs, coordinate the people and dependencies required to deliver them, and ensure the resulting data is genuinely useful for evaluating and improving LLMs and agents. You’ll also manage vendors and build the processes, tooling, and operating rhythms that allow HUD to deliver reliably at increasing scale.

Responsibilities

Own data and evaluation programs end-to-end, from initial scoping and requirements gathering through production, quality assurance, delivery, and retrospective

Maintain and improve delivery pipelines at scale, which includes managing external vendors throughout the delivery lifecycle

Experience owning complex technical programs in AI/ML, data operations, support engineering, applied research, forward-deployed engineering, or a similarly cross-functional environment
Strong quantitative and qualitative judgment about data—you can move between aggregate metrics and individual examples to determine whether a dataset or evaluation is useful, reliable, and representative
Experience maintaining and improving complex processes, especially within project delivery or data contexts
Demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguous problems, maintain momentum as requirements change, and make sound tradeoffs without waiting for a perfect specification
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn messy technical information into clear decisions, owners, and next steps

jobs.title: Senior Staff Technical Program Manager - Moveworks
jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Team & Role

Moveworks, now part of ServiceNow, is building the agentic AI layer that sits between every employee and the systems they rely on. Following the acquisition, the Moveworks Business Unit is one of the most strategically important investments at ServiceNow — and the scope of what we own is expanding fast. We are looking for a Director-level Technical Program Manager (Individual Contributor) to lead our most critical programs end to end, starting with the ServiceNow integration and growing into a broader portfolio over time as the BU scales.

This is a senior, highly technical IC role for someone who has spent most of their career running infrastructure, platform modernization, or large-scale distributed systems programs. You will manage the program — directly, end to end — and your influence will come from technical depth, sharp judgment, and an ability to align engineering leaders, executives, and partner organizations around a single execution plan. As the Moveworks BU scope expands, so will yours.

What You Get To Do In This Role

Own the Moveworks Infrastructure portfolio of strategic and technical initiatives. Your primary focus will be to drive the roadmap and execution plans for Moveworks Infrastructure initiatives; as you scale you will also take over from engineering infra operational processes like capacity planning and budgeting
Focus on initiatives expanding MW Infra footprint. We are moving to a tri-cloud + on-prem + SPC strategy where we need to develop the tools and process for managing our infra stack across diverse environments. Align any ambiguous strategic direction into concrete milestones, dependencies, and decision points.
Run the program, not the people. As the TPM, you will be the connective tissue across engineering, product, design, security, GTM, finance, and field organizations — driving outcomes through clarity, structured decision-making, and relentless follow-through.
Identify and resolve technical misalignment. Spot misalignment across teams, architectures, and roadmaps early — before it becomes a delivery risk — and partner with engineering leads to drive resolution quickly. Lead architecture reviews, surface cross-system risks (latency budgets, blast radius, multi-tenancy, AI safety, evals), and broker tradeoffs between engineering teams.
Build the operating system for the program. Status, risk, scope, and decision logs that engineering directors and VPs actually read. Quarterly planning rhythms that reflect reality. Executive narratives that are honest about where things stand.
Be the senior partner to engineering leadership. Pair directly with Distinguished Engineers, VPs of Engineering, and product leaders. Represent the program to the CTO, CPO, and executive staff. Own the message.
Define TPM excellence. As we grow and expand our TPM team, you will serve as the model for how to operate. Set the standard for what senior technical program management looks like at Moveworks, mentor TPMs across the org without being their manager, and codify the patterns that scale.

Qualifications

Required:

12+ years of technical program management experience, with most of that time spent on infrastructure, platform, cloud, reliability, developer productivity, or modernization programs. You have operated at staff, principal, or director IC scope on programs where the hard part was not coordination alone, but understanding technical dependencies, sequencing migrations, managing reliability risk, and helping engineering leaders make durable tradeoffs.
Deep technical fluency across infrastructure modernization domains — distributed systems, cloud-native infrastructure, Kubernetes, multi-region and multi-cloud architectures, hyperscaler platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity, data platforms, observability, reliability, and migration strategy. You do not need to be the architect, but you need enough technical depth to pressure-test plans, spot cross-system risk, and earn credibility with senior engineers.
A track record of leading cross-org programs involving 100+ engineers, multiple VPs, and competing roadmaps — ideally including at least one large-scale integration, migration, or platform unification.
Excellent written communication. You can compress a 200-engineer program into a one-page exec narrative without losing the truth of it. You write decision docs that hold up under scrutiny.
Strong technical judgment under ambiguity. You know when to dig in, when to delegate to engineering leads, and when to escalate. You are comfortable saying “this plan won’t work” in a room full of senior leaders.

Strongly Preferred

Prior IC senior TPM experience at a hyperscaler, large SaaS platform, or AI-first company.
Comfort operating across SaaS, on-prem regulated, and government cloud (FedRAMP, IL5) deployment models.
Experience leading post-acquisition technical integration programs at scale.
Background in agentic AI, conversational AI, or AI assistant platforms — you understand why agent runtimes, tool calling, RAG, and evals are not the same problem.

What Success Looks Like In The First Year

Quarter 1: You have a grasp of the Moveworks replatform roadmap and are driving the execution plan for the first release helping the team address blockers. Engineering leaders across ServiceNow and Moveworks trust your judgment and pull you into the rooms that matter.
Quarter 2: You are able to scale to drive multiple releases going on in parallel on the Moveworks replatforming roadmap as well as the current infrastructure expansion and improvement initiatives, and proactively surface key risks to the plans and drive the path to mitigation. The executive staff has confidence in the plan because the plan is honest.
Quarter 3-4: Team has successfully delivered 1 or 2 releases on the roadmap under your leadership; major milestones land on time and at quality, and you are a trusted partner for infrastructure leadership and team

Why This Role

This role is especially compelling for senior TPMs who have operated in high-scale infrastructure environments and want more ownership than a narrowly-scoped platform program can offer. You will get the scale, technical complexity, and executive visibility of a large technology company, combined with the pace, ambiguity, and scope expansion of a fast-growing AI business unit.

Most senior TPM roles come with a fixed scope and focus on driving meetings and reporting the status. This one is different. It is a seat at the center of the Moveworks BU which is growing at an unprecented rate — your scope will expand as the BU scales. You will be measured by the technical and business outcomes you drive. If you thrive in an environment where you have the agency to move the needle for the company and learn something new every single day, then this role is for you.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $190,900 - $334,100, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs.

Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. jobs.title: CX Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Position: CX Operations Analyst

Location:
On Site El Monte, San Jose or Richmond CA

Position Type:
Full-time - Exempt

Reports To:
Director, Infrastructure & Planning

Salary:
$85,000- $118,000 + 15% Bonus and full benefits day one

Who We Are

Flexcar is completely reimagining car ownership. We offer the world's first month-to-month car lease, with insurance and maintenance included. By combining operational expertise with technology, data, and AI, we are transforming every aspect of the customer journey and providing a smarter, more flexible alternative to traditional ownership.

We're scaling fast - and we're building the operating systems, products, and insights to scale with us.

About The Role

The CX Operations Analyst sits at the intersection of Customer Experience, Product, Engineering, Operations, and Finance. This role turns customer interactions and operational data into clear insights, product requirements, and process improvements that reduce customer effort, improve retention, and help Flexcar scale efficiently.

You will own recurring CX and operational reporting, investigate the root causes behind customer contacts and service failures, and build analyses that show where product, policy, workflow, or tooling changes will have the greatest impact. You will also maintain visibility into customer-facing bugs and experience gaps, partner with Product and Engineering through validation and launch, and measure whether solutions produced the intended result.

This is not a reporting-only role. The strongest person in this position is curious, technically capable, and comfortable moving from a SQL query or dashboard to a customer journey, a product working session, and an executive recommendation. You are expected to make the data usable, tell the story behind it, and help the business act.

What You'll Own

CX, Product, and Customer-Journey Analytics

Analyze customer contacts, behaviors, and outcomes across the full journey - including prospecting, approval, pickup, active membership, service, return, cancellation, and reactivation.
Maintain contact-driver and contact-rate reporting, identify the root causes behind remaining demand, and recommend product, policy, self-service, AI, or operational changes that reduce avoidable contacts.
Evaluate customer churn, retention, and loyalty impacts associated with pricing changes, service changes, product launches, and other strategic initiatives.
Synthesize Care CSAT, pickup and return surveys, NPS, customer conversations, and operational events into clear themes and compelling business cases for leadership, Product, and Operations.
Analyze the incremental value generated through Care activities, including new and returning customers, collections effectiveness, recovery efforts, and revenue-related customer interventions.

Reporting, Data Products, and Governance

Build and maintain dashboards and analytical products that make customer and operational performance accessible to leaders across Flexcar.
Identify trends and translate them into recommendations for Care and operational leaders.
Develop and improve core reporting such as Customer Funnel, True Customer Contact, Contact Rate and Root-Cause Analysis, Post-Pickup Experience, service and roadside event analysis, and Finance WBR automation.
Maintain a clear glossary of CX data sources, metric definitions, business logic, and known limitations so teams interpret results consistently.
Partner with Data Engineering to validate Redshift and source-system data, resolve discrepancies, and ensure reporting remains accurate as platforms and workflows change.

Product and Engineering Partnership

Maintain a centralized customer-facing issue and bug board covering billing, app, account, migration, and workflow failures; quantify customer impact, identify patterns, and drive issues to the right Product or Engineering owner.
Translate customer and operational findings into clear problem statements, business requirements, acceptance criteria, and measurement plans for product and process improvements.
Support product discovery and prioritization by sizing the affected population, contact volume, customer effort, retention risk, revenue impact, and operational cost of identified problems.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Design, and frontline teams to test workflows, validate data, support releases, and determine whether changes solved the intended customer problem.
Represent the operational and customer perspective in working sessions while remaining grounded in evidence rather than individual anecdotes.

Care Technology, AI, and Workflow Optimization

Support integrations and workflow design across Care's third-party tools, CRM, telephony, workforce-management, analytics, and AI platforms to improve efficiency, accuracy, and customer continuity.
Monitor the launch and ongoing performance of AI-assisted workflows and tools, including containment, accuracy, handoffs, resolution outcomes, customer sentiment, and operational adoption.
Identify redundant tools, manual workarounds, fragmented data, and workflow gaps; analyze their value and partner with business and technical owners on simplification.
Identify where agents or operations teams cannot efficiently resolve a customer need because of missing data, permissions, product capability, unclear process, or system design.
Support customer segmentation and tagging initiatives that improve reporting, routing, personalization, and measurement across the customer journey.

Operational CX and Process Improvement

Connect site-level customer feedback and operational performance to Care contacts so Flexcar can identify where local execution creates downstream customer effort.
Monitor customer-facing operational measures such as post-pickup experience, damage reporting, pre-pickup checklist exceptions, roadside and maintenance contacts, and other SOP-compliance signals.
Conduct targeted deep dives into outlier experiences, recurring failures, and high-cost contact patterns; establish the root cause, recommended action, owner, and success measure.
Create leadership-ready readouts that distinguish individual execution issues from unclear policy, broken process, product limitations, and systemic operating constraints.
Track recommendations through implementation and post-launch measurement so insights consistently result in action and measurable improvement.

Experience

What We're Looking For:

3+ years of experience in business analysis, product analytics, CX analytics, operations analytics, product operations, or a similarly cross-functional analytical role.
Experience using customer, product, and operational data to identify root causes, influence priorities, and improve processes or customer journeys.
Demonstrated ability to write and run complex, large-scale SQL queries and analyze high-volume datasets, translating findings into actionable insights that improve processes, productivity, and operational performance.
Experience developing dashboards, maintaining recurring performance reporting, and validating data across multiple source systems.
Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams through discovery, requirements definition, testing, launch, and post-launch measurement.
Experience in a contact center, subscription business, marketplace, mobility, logistics, or multi-site operation is preferred.

Skills

Strong SQL, spreadsheet, dashboarding, and data-visualization skills; experience with Sigma, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or a comparable business-intelligence platform.
Ability to connect quantitative analysis with qualitative customer feedback and explain both in clear business language.
Strong problem framing and requirements-writing skills, including the ability to define the affected customer, root cause, business impact, desired outcome, and measurement plan.
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to create concise executive readouts and facilitate detailed working sessions with technical and operational partners.
Strong organization and follow-through; able to manage recurring reporting, investigations, and cross-functional projects without losing ownership or deadlines.
Familiarity with contact-center, CRM, WFM, product analytics, or customer-support platforms such as Five9, Kustomer, Assembled, and similar tools is helpful.

Traits

Curious and investigative - you keep asking why until the underlying customer or operating problem is clear.
Product-minded - you do not stop at reporting a trend; you define what should change and how success should be measured.
Comfortable with ambiguity - you can create structure when data, ownership, or processes are still evolving.
Direct and collaborative - you surface problems early, bring evidence, and work constructively with the teams responsible for solving them.
High ownership - you treat data accuracy, business clarity, and closing the loop on recommendations as your responsibility.

What Success Looks Like In Year One

Leadership has a trusted, consistent view of customer contacts, contact drivers, operational CX, retention signals, and the cost and value of Care activity.
Core dashboards - including Contact Rate and Root-Cause Analysis, Customer Funnel, True Customer Contact, Post-Pickup Experience, and event-based service analysis - are accurate, documented, and actively used in decision-making.
The customer-facing issue and bug board provides clear visibility into affected customers, severity, business impact, ownership, and resolution progress.
Product and Engineering partners receive well-supported problem statements and requirements, and major releases include defined CX success measures and post-launch evaluation.
Recurring customer pain points are converted into measurable product, AI, policy, workflow, or operational improvements rather than repeatedly appearing in reporting.
Data definitions and sources are documented, critical reporting is validated, and teams spend less time debating the numbers and more time acting on them.
Flexcar can clearly demonstrate where customer-experience improvements reduced effort, protected retention, improved revenue, or lowered operating cost.

What Tops The Tank

Rest & Relaxation: Flexible PTO policy.
Future Savings: 401(k) plan with company match from day one.
Benefits: Excellent, low-cost medical, dental, and vision coverage from day one.
Drive a Flexcar: Discounted employee pricing and no annual membership fee.
Weekly pay and other employee perks.

As a Senior Project Manager (Water Resources/Stormwater)
, you will serve as a senior-level project manager and technical leader responsible for delivering complex water resources, stormwater, and surface water engineering projects. In this role, you will lead multidisciplinary teams, provide technical oversight, and drive innovative solutions that support successful project outcomes for a diverse range of clients.
You will be recognized as a subject matter expert in areas such as hydrology, hydraulics, floodplain analysis, stormwater systems, and watershed management. From project pursuit through delivery, you will apply advanced technical expertise to manage high-impact projects while ensuring quality, regulatory compliance, and client satisfaction.
This position also plays a key role in strengthening client relationships, supporting business development efforts, generating revenue opportunities, mentoring staff, and contributing to the strategic growth of the practice. The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader who is passionate about technical excellence, team development, and delivering meaningful solutions that positively impact communities and the environment.

Leads technically complex hydrologic and hydraulic analyses, modeling efforts, and engineering studies across all project phases.
Develops, reviews, and approves engineering designs, calculations, drainage studies, floodplain analyses, grading plans, storm drain systems, and stormwater management solutions.
Oversees preparation of technical reports, feasibility studies, engineering analyses, construction documents, specifications, and construction-phase support activities.
Serves as a subject matter expert in stormwater management, watershed planning, flood risk reduction, drainage infrastructure, BMP implementation, and regulatory compliance.
Utilizes advanced engineering tools and software including ArcGIS, HEC-RAS, HEC-HMS, FLO-2D, AutoCAD/Civil 3D, SWMM, and related platforms.

Provides senior review and technical oversight for project deliverables and critical project decisions.
Ensures projects are delivered efficiently while maintaining quality and client satisfaction.

Regulatory Compliance and Quality Assurance

Ensures compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, engineering standards, design criteria, and permitting requirements.
Maintains advanced knowledge of California stormwater regulations, NPDES programs, and stormwater BMP requirements.
Identifies and resolves complex technical and regulatory challenges throughout project delivery.
Establishes and enforces QA/QC standards for engineering reports, plans, studies, and technical deliverables.
Promotes adherence to safety requirements, project standards, and engineering best practices.

Technical Leadership and Mentorship

Serves as a firm-wide technical resource for water resources and stormwater engineering.
Mentors junior and mid-level engineers in technical development, project execution, and professional growth.
Provides technical guidance, coaching, and constructive feedback to project teams.
Supports development of technical standards, best practices, and training initiatives.
Contributes to building technical depth and future leadership within the practice.

Innovation and Process Improvement

Evaluates and implements emerging technologies, analytical methods, and engineering tools to improve project outcomes and operational efficiency.
Develops methodologies, workflows, templates, and best practices that enhance technical quality and reduce project risk.
Champions continuous improvement initiatives across engineering and project delivery processes.
Remains current on industry trends, regulatory changes, and advancements in water resources and stormwater engineering.

Business Development and Industry Engagement

Develops and maintains strategic client relationships across public and private sectors.
Supports and leads proposal development, project pursuits, contract negotiations, and client presentations.
Identifies opportunities for business growth and revenue generation.
Develops scopes of work, schedules, budgets, and cost estimates for engineering services.
Represents the firm through professional organizations, industry events, conferences, and client engagements.
Contributes to Dudek's reputation as a leader in water resources and stormwater engineering.

Minimum Qualifications

Experience: 18+ years of experience in water resources, stormwater, civil, or environmental engineering, including progressive project management responsibilities.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
Licensure: Professional Engineer (PE) license in California or ability to obtain California licensure.
Advanced expertise in hydrology, hydraulics, floodplain analysis, stormwater engineering, drainage systems, grading design, and watershed management.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects, lead multidisciplinary teams, manage project financial performance, and deliver successful client outcomes.
Strong technical writing, communication, leadership, and client management skills.
Must possess a valid driver’s license and have active personal automobile liability insurance by the first day of employment

Experience with stormwater BMP design, flood mitigation planning, watershed studies, and drainage master planning.
Proficiency with ArcGIS, HEC-RAS, HEC-HMS, FLO-2D, SWMM, AutoCAD/Civil 3D, and other water resources modeling and design software.

Experience mentoring and developing engineering staff while maintaining high standards of technical quality and project delivery.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Differentiated Security Team
new_jobs.description:
Description

Do you want to turn recurring security gaps into enterprise-wide solutions that protect millions of customers? As a Senior Technical Program Manager on Amazon's Differentiated Security Team, you will lead a program that identifies systemic security challenges surfaced through acquisitions and partner engagements, proves solutions work in real environments, and transitions them to long-term owners. This is a high-visibility role where you will define program strategy, influence senior leaders, and drive cross-functional delivery across security engineering, business security, and infrastructure teams. If you thrive in ambiguity, build consensus across organizations, and are energized by turning complex problems into simple, scalable solutions - we want to talk to you.

This is not a maintenance role. You will build the program's operational framework from the ground up by defining how security signals enter the pipeline, how initiatives are prioritized, and what "done" looks like. You will work at the intersection of mergers and acquisitions, security engineering, and enterprise infrastructure, giving you a vantage point into security challenges that most teams never see.

What Makes This Role Unique

You see security problems before anyone else. M&A integrations and partner engagements surface gaps in non-standard environments that standard security teams do not encounter
Every initiative has a finish line. You prove solutions work, then hand them off. You are a transient owner by design, not a permanent operator.
You shape the program, not just run it. The operational model, lifecycle framework, and prioritization rubric are being built now. You will have direct influence over how this program works for years to come
Your work has enterprise-wide impact. Solutions born from this program scale across dozens of business units and hundreds of thousands of applications.

Key job responsibilities

Own the end-to-end lifecycle of a security solutions program from signal identification through proof-of-concept, investment pitch, and transition to a funded long-term owner
Define program strategy, build prioritization mechanisms, and create measurable success criteria that keep a portfolio of concurrent initiatives on track
Drive cross-functional delivery across security engineering, business security, and infrastructure teams - often in environments with non-standard technology stacks
Write strategic narratives and present trade-offs, progress, and investment recommendations to Directors and VPs
Build mechanisms such as intake rubrics, initiative registries, and stage-gate frameworks that make the program repeatable and scalable beyond any single person.

A day in the life

You might start the morning facilitating a cross-functional design review to evaluate whether an existing security solution can close a newly identified gap, or whether a new approach is needed. After lunch, you could be writing an investment narrative to transition a validated solution to its long-term owner. When an active acquisition closes, you may step in as the integration TPM - coordinating security workstreams across engineering, infrastructure, and the acquired business to drive Day 1 readiness and post-close milestones. No two days look the same; the program spans concurrent initiatives at different lifecycle stages, and you keep them all moving forward.

About The Team

Our team enables Amazon to securely capture new revenue streams through mergers and acquisitions. We lead security integration for newly acquired businesses - coordinating across engineering, infrastructure, and compliance teams to drive risk reduction and security posture parity in environments where standard solutions do not yet reach. Our Security Initiatives program operates as a solution incubator: we identify systemic security challenges surfaced through acquisitions and partnerships, prove solutions work, and hand them to funded long-term owners. You will join a globally distributed team of security engineers and technical program managers who value data-driven decisions, partnership, and building durable capabilities for the enterprise.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
6+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
Experience leading highly technical programs involving infrastructure, complex systems, systems engineering
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience building and evaluating system-level technical design
Knowledge of information security principles, including risk management frameworks and security control domains (e.g., identity and access management, vulnerability management, incident response, cloud security)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing or supporting Mergers and Acquisitions security integration programs, including pre-close diligence coordination and post-close security onboarding
Experience leveraging AI-augmented tools or practices to accelerate security operations, risk scoring, or remediation workflows

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

new_jobs.title: Senior Cloud Architect & Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Description

About The Role

The Senior Cloud Architect & Program Manager is a senior technical leadership role responsible for defining and executing the organization's cloud strategy, architecting scalable and secure cloud solutions and driving major modernization initiatives from concept through delivery. This role bridges enterprise architecture, project delivery, and cross-functional leadership — partnering with business and engineering teams to deliver cloud solutions that are cost-effective, resilient, and aligned with organizational priorities

Responsibilities

Cloud Strategy & Architecture

Define and maintain the organization's cloud strategy and long-term architectural roadmap
Design and implement scalable, secure, and resilient cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure.
Lead cloud architecture decisions across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS models.
Establish governance, security, and compliance frameworks for Azure environments.
Optimize cloud costs and performance through architecture reviews and automation.
Provide technical leadership on Azure migrations, hybrid cloud integrations, and DevOps enablement.

Program & Project Leadership

Lead the development and execution of coordinated, enterprise-scale plans and technology programs.
Drive high-priority, high-complexity projects requiring significant resources and cross-functional coordination.
Engage regularly with executive stakeholders to communicate program status, resolve escalations, and influence future technology initiatives.
Deliver clear, structured presentations on project status, risks, and outcomes to senior leadership.
Represent the Technology division in cross-departmental teams focused on key strategic initiatives.

Project & Delivery Management

Manage projects from inception through final implementation, coordinating across end users, vendors, and internal teams.
Define project scope, assign responsibilities, identify resources, and build schedules to ensure on-time delivery.
Manage project financials against assigned budgets: forecast requirements, track expenditures, analyze variances, and initiate corrective actions.
Ensure adherence to delivery standards and review all project deliverables for quality and completeness.
Identify and resolve risks for at-risk programs, organizing resources and solutions proactively.
Produce key project artifacts as needed — including business requirements documentation, project plans, test scripts, and change management logs.
Ensure all project information is current and accurate; provide regular high-level briefings to executive management.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, Communications, or a related field from an accredited institution.
10+ years of progressively responsible experience, with at least 5 years in Azure architecture or cloud leadership roles.
Proven track record managing multiple, complex enterprise-level technology projects simultaneously, including inter-dependent stakeholders across internal and external organizations.
Experience developing program and project strategies that achieve business goals, with demonstrated understanding of impacts on diverse stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams, including Regulatory Agencies and external partners.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to resolve issues that cross departmental boundaries.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with executive-level presentation ability.
Ability to travel to Port Authority facilities as required.

Desired Qualifications

Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer).
Experience with FinOps practices and cloud cost management frameworks.
Familiarity with government or regulated industry technology environments.
PMP, PgMP, or equivalent project management certification.

Selection Process

The application process varies by position, but typically includes an initial phone interview for qualified candidates, followed by a more in-depth interview(s) and/or assessment(s). Selected candidates who are made a conditional job offer will be asked to undergo a background check.

Compensation, Benefits & On-Site Collaboration Requirements

In accordance with Port Authority policy, this position permits employees to work remotely a maximum of one day per week, subject to operational and business needs.

The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey anticipates that the actual salary offered to a successful candidate will depend on aspects such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal factors.

The expected compensation range for this role is: Minimum: $ 147,290 Midpoint: $ 191,486 Maximum: $ 235,664

The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey offers a competitive benefits package and a professional environment that supports development and recognizes achievement.

Click here
for more information about benefits, our culture, and career development opportunities.

How To Apply

Interested candidates should apply to this job by clicking on the "Apply Now" button and submitting a resume. The Port Authority of NY & NJ welcomes veteran and military spouse applications.

Only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

About The Port Authority

Founded in 1921, the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey builds, operates, and maintains many of the most important transportation and trade infrastructure assets in the country. The agency's network of aviation, ground, rail, and seaport facilities is among the busiest in the country, supports more than 550,000 regional jobs, and generates more than twenty three billion in annual wages and eighty billion in annual economic activity. The Port Authority also owns and manages the 16-acre World Trade Center site, where the 1,776-foot-tall One World Trade Center is now the tallest skyscraper in the Western Hemisphere.

Equal Opportunity Employer

The Port Authority of New York & New Jersey/Port Authority Trans-Hudson (PATH) is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

It is the Port Authority’s policy, in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and other applicable laws, to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified persons with disabilities who are employees or applicants for employment and who request the Port Authority do so, unless providing the requested accommodation would result in an undue hardship to the Port Authority.

Job applicants may request a reasonable accommodation (1) if they claim a disability is affecting the interview process, or (2) to ensure that if they are selected for a position, they can perform the essential job functions. To submit a request, please contact the recruiter or email the Human Resources Department’s Disability Accommodation Coordinator at [email protected] .

The Port Authority will treat any request for Reasonable Accommodation by a job applicant confidentially.
