Overview

We are seeking a full-time Program Manager Medical Devices
in our Olathe, KS location. In this role, you will be responsible for serving as a leader and mentor for successful medical device product lifecycle activities and/or process initiatives through documenting and coordinating the implementation of regulatory requirements and leading moderately complex programs per medical device processes. This role also analyzes post-market surveillance trends, identifies key changes in regulation, and acts as primary program support for one or more regulatory jurisdictions.

Essential Functions

Development and management of requirements/specifications and traceability to testing
Anticipates regulatory obstacles and emerging issues throughout development and drives solutions with other members of regulatory and related teams
Coordinates QMS activities to support the achievement of milestones
Generates documentation to be submitted to various governmental regulatory agencies to secure approvals to market products in secondary regions
Assists in management of usability/clinical study activities
Develops training plans/activities
Performs tool validation activities against established processes
Reports on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to adhere to process and prevent occurrence of any non-conformity relating to product or process
Assists with generating corrective/preventive action (CAPA) plans and participating in internal audits
Consistently provides clear and accurate documentation and understands level of detail necessary to ensure accurate reporting
Identifies and resolves conflicts through understanding of interdependencies of and development of effective relationships between the development teams, other Garmin teams/departments, and external entities (e.g. customers, suppliers, etc.)
Provisions the timely documentation of clear scope (detailed assumptions, internal/external/regulatory requirements), objectives/targets, validation needs, resource estimates (costs, timing)
Leverages advanced communication skills to ensure team members/stakeholders are appropriately informed, leads tradeoff discussions and drives decisions to keep program moving forward
Supports creation and maintenance of complex timelines and milestone tracking, including application of program metrics and risk management principles to identify and mitigate schedule impacting items
Drives development and issue resolution through identification of risks/issues, creation of mitigation plans and identification of issues which impact other products
With some guidance, performs market research in support of product definition and/or business development initiatives
Provides reliable solutions to a variety of problems using sound problem solving techniques
Identifies and resolves issues/risks using proper tools and techniques, including support of root cause and corrective actions for given problems
Leads small to mid-size medical device program activities as part of a greater program and may lead larger program initiatives
Collaborates and adds value in medical device design reviews
Makes substantial contributions to determine feasibility of medical device program goals/objectives and ensures clear documentation of scope; applies knowledge in evaluating proposed program initiatives
Communicates status of work clearly providing visibility to supervisor and key stakeholders

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in a technical discipline AND a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience OR an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
Excellent academic qualifications (cumulative GPA greater than or equal to 3.0 as a general rule)
Demonstrates ability to analyze a problem to root cause, brainstorm/offer solutions, align with stakeholders and execute
Demonstrates full use of accepted standards and procedures
Demonstrates proficient use and knowledge of medical device regulation
Understands production and operations issues as they relate to medical device program management
Applies Garmin’s Mission, Vision, Values and Quality Policy and exhibits enthusiasm for and a desire to see Garmin succeed
Demonstrates excellent time management, organizational and follow-up skills
Demonstrates a sense of urgency, commitment, and focus on the right priorities in developing solutions in a timely fashion
Demonstrates strong and effective verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
Ability to execute well-defined, moderately complex tasks and/or medical device programs
Ability to drive the various elements of assigned tasks and/or medical device programs forward
Able to offer some suggestions to improve processes
Ability to perform as a medical device program leader who drives the overall progress of assigned tasks towards completion
Capable of mentoring PM Level 1

Desired Qualifications

Involvement with programs subject to regulated processes and quality management systems
Knowledge of FDA medical device quality system regulation (QSR) and requirements
Knowledge of European medical device regulation (EU MDR)
Knowledge of medical device IEC/ISO standards
Relevant job experience and/or training with one or more of the subjects listed above

. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank—and we need talent like you to help us get there.

Are you passionate about international trade
? Do you have experience in Structured Trade Finance solutions
? Do you enjoy collaborating with diverse teams across countries and functions? If you answered yes, we want to hear from you.

What you will do

Global Trade Solutions (GTS)
comprises 4,500+ colleagues across 50+ countries
, supporting suppliers and buyers with export and import finance needs. Trade is where HSBC began in 1865
, when we financed commerce between Europe and Asia.

The purpose of this role is to lead the successful end-to-end implementation of Global Trade Solutions deals
, including onboarding of complex deals across the GTS product suite for clients located across European geographies. You’ll drive delivery from client kick-off through funding, including scoping and Statement of Work
creation, using proven methodologies to deliver a high-quality client experience while accelerating revenue realisation for the bank.

In this role you will

Lead end-to-end implementation of Structured Finance deals and selected Core Trade products
Partner closely with Sales, Operations, Technology and Services, providing implementation consultancy to clients
Manage project delivery and technical onboarding, including UAT and PVT testing to complete programme set-up successfully
Build strong working relationships with key stakeholders across GTS Frontline/Structuring, Coverage (including senior management), IT, Change Delivery, Service Delivery, and global functions (e.g., Risk, Finance)
Drive cross-business collaboration to ensure strategy alignment, improve efficiency, and share best practices with appropriate senior escalation
Project manage multiple deals/programmes concurrently, acting as the central point of contact for internal and external stakeholders
Develop and execute implementation plans using structured project management methodologies; guide clients on responsibilities and tasks within the plan
Host and attend regular client meetings to track progress, provide accurate status updates, and escalate risks/issues impacting client experience
Identify process gaps and improvement opportunities; take ownership of initiatives that improve delivery and client outcomes
Adapt and prioritise effectively across multiple stakeholders and competing demands, maintaining open and transparent communication with Sales, Product and Coverage

Knowledge of Core Trade solutions, with experience in Supply Chain Finance and Receivables Finance
Demonstrated project management experience, ideally with complex multi-stakeholder deliveries
Strong stakeholder management skills across Operations, Technology and Client Service, including at senior client level
Proven ability to support complex global corporates and multi-million-dollar programmes
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a results-driven approach and consistent delivery on time and to quality
Understanding of Working Capital Management concepts and Open Account/Supply Chain/Receivables propositions and business models
Confidence working in a cross-functional, matrix organisation across international markets and culturally diverse teams
Ability to manage (or contribute meaningfully to) discussions on relevant legal frameworks for Open Account structures

French and English language skills (preferred)

Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Key job responsibilities

Program Leadership: Lead large-scale, complex technical programs across multiple teams and disciplines, from inception to delivery
Strategic Planning: Develop and execute comprehensive program plans aligned with Leo's mission and business objectives
Cross-functional Coordination: Orchestrate efforts across engineering, operations, product, and business teams to ensure seamless program execution
Risk Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate risks that could impact program success, developing contingency plans as needed
Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain relationships with senior leadership, external partners, and regulatory bodies, ensuring clear communication and alignment
Technical Expertise: Leverage technical understanding to facilitate decision-making and problem-solving across teams
Process Improvement: Implement and optimize program management methodologies to increase efficiency and scalability

A day in the life

As a Technical Program Manager on the Leo Devices & Systems Infrastructure team, you'll drive the development and operations programs for service environments and ServiceNow. Your day involves leading and being a part of cross-functional stand-with stakeholders, shared service owners, security and export compliance while collaborating with engineering leads to address technical challenges. You'll analyze fleet health metrics and compliance data to guide program decisions, present status updates to leadership, and coordinate with external partners like ServiceNow and Taninum. You will lead implementation programs for which the team has ownership in delivery of the outcome with programs ranging from deploying new software to transformation of existing services. You and your team will play a crucial role in Leo's mission to deliver reliable internet globally through innovative device management solutions and automation.

7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

The Velocity Labs team mission is to think beyond the confines of the normal product-orientated approach and to discover new ways to apply and embrace agentic AI. We have noticed how the open-source community, and some of our competitors, experiment with new ideas, and deliver initial products fast. With Velocity Labs we are building an organization that can move faster, explore more, and make sure AWS is at the cutting edge of innovation in agentic AI.

We are looking for people who are hands-on builders, have strong curiosity, strong bias for action, and maintain high standards. If you can work collaboratively, learn quickly, and deliver results, you are likely a fit for this team.

Agentic AI drives innovation at the forefront of artificial intelligence, enabling customers to transform their businesses through cutting-edge AI solutions. We build and deliver the foundational AI services that power the future of cloud computing, helping organizations harness the potential of AI to solve their most complex challenges. Join our dynamic team of AI/ML practitioners, applied scientists, software engineers, and solution architects who work backwards from customer needs to create groundbreaking technologies. new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Maritime
new_jobs.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn , X , Instagram , and YouTube .

We are looking for an exceptional Senior Staff Technical Program Manager to join our Maritime Domain team, integrating Shield AI’s Hivemind Autonomy stack onto Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USVs) and, in the future, Unmanned Undersea Vehicles (UUVs). Your role will include starting programs from the ground up and guiding them through production and into operational employment. This role requires a self-starter who can integrate quickly with a fast-moving, highly competent team.

You will drive alignment across software development and integration activities with domestic and international customers while remaining synchronized with Business Development colleagues. This role requires close coordination with colleagues across Shield AI’s international teams, including offices in Europe and Asia, and a motivated, cross-functional leadership approach.

The ideal candidate has a combination of government and commercial program management experience, with strong, established fundamentals in coordinating complex, first-of-a-kind integration efforts. You will be responsible for driving cost, schedule, integration readiness, risk management, and successful operational outcomes while pushing the boundaries of maritime autonomy. We are looking for a candidate who can think critically and creatively while leveraging a firm foundation in managing risk across new and foundational programs.

What you'll do:

Lead Assigned Unmanned Surface Vehicle (USV) Autonomy and Future Unmanned Undersea Vehicle (UUV) Integration Programs

Serve as the program manager for assigned USV programs, leading the integration of Shield AI’s Hivemind autonomy software onto USV platforms.
Support the development and execution of future UUV autonomy integration programs as opportunities mature.

Establish Clear Objectives

Work closely with product managers, engineering leads, operations, and executive leadership to define clear program objectives tied to mission impact, customer success, strategic growth, financial outcomes, and technical performance.

Program & Project Management

Own the development and execution of integrated program and project plans, including scope, schedules, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and resource allocation. Continuously evaluate and rebalance customer priorities, technical risks, cost constraints, and schedule demands throughout the program.

Drive Timely, High-Quality Decisions

Facilitate rigorous, fast, and effective technical and programmatic decision-making across cross-functional teams. While not expected to design systems directly, you will possess sufficient technical depth to identify risks, challenge assumptions, and drive alignment. Hands-on experience with software or autonomy products is an accelerator.

Integration & Test Readiness

Coordinate system integration activities across labs, ground testing, and sea trial operations. Drive readiness reviews, integration milestones, and closure of technical dependencies required to support successful USV/UUV integration and operational deployment.
Identify potential bottlenecks, critical-path risks, and schedule delays, and drive mitigation strategies to achieve program milestones and delivery commitments. Conduct critical-path analyses and support program execution through Gate Reviews, Program Management Reviews (PMRs), and Estimates at Completion (EACs).

Communicate with Excellence

Drive a consistent cadence of well-organized, effective meetings, including preparation, facilitation, action tracking, and follow-up. Ensure stakeholders remain aligned on status, milestones, priorities, risks, integration readiness, and technical challenges.

Drive Technical Execution

Support the development and refinement of technical and operational documentation, engineering change orders, work instructions, service bulletins, operational procedures, and integration documentation.

Empower Teams & Remove Obstacles

Create an environment where teams have the clarity, tools, accountability, and support needed to execute effectively. Escalate issues quickly, streamline processes, eliminate blockers, and foster a culture of ownership, urgency, and continuous improvement.

Deliver Outcomes

Drive accurate and timely tracking and reporting of program financials, resources, schedules, integration status, and customer deliverables.

Support Growth & Strategic Initiatives

Support business development activities related to current and future autonomy integration programs, including proposals, requests for information (RFIs), requests for proposals (RFPs), technical evaluations, and strategic customer engagements.

Required qualifications:

Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 9 years and a Master’s degree; or 7 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience.
Experience leading complex cross-functional engineering programs from concept through production and operational deployment.
Strong technical understanding of software-enabled systems, autonomy, aerospace systems, or complex integrated products.
Demonstrated success managing program execution across scope, schedule, budget, risk, and technical performance in fast-paced environments.
Experience with Program Management Reviews (PMRs), gate reviews, and estimates.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead through influence across distributed teams.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills in fast-paced environments.
Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and ability to drive execution with high standards and collaboration.
Willingness to travel internationally

Preferred qualifications:

Experience integrating autonomy or software systems onto defense platforms.
Experience in software development, autonomy development, or systems engineering.
Experience managing clean-sheet defense or technology development programs.
PMP and/or Certified Scrum Master (CSM) certification.
Familiarity with DoD contracting, defense acquisition, or national security programs.
Experience balancing aggressive timelines with complex engineering constraints.
Eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret clearance or higher.

new_jobs.description:
Description

Leidos is seeking a proven technical program management leader with deep experience leading large‑scale mission software development, full‑lifecycle modernization
, and distributed engineering organizations.
The ideal candidate has directed complex software programs
, overseen multi‑discipline teams delivering secure, high‑performance capabilities, and demonstrated authoritative leadership across architecture, integration, DevOps, cyber, and cloud environments. Candidates must bring hands‑on credibility in software development and sustainment, not just program oversight, with a track record of delivering mission‑critical systems for the Department of Defense and Intelligence Community.

This role requires meaningful technical credibility, disciplined program leadership, and demonstrated success running large‑scale, full‑lifecycle software development and sustainment programs exceeding $20M/year. Consider that Mission System Modernization is a continually challenging requirement that demands modernization of legacy mission systems into secure cloud, hybrid, or containerized architectures, ensuring resilience, scalability, and future ready capability delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Program Leadership of Large-Scale Program: Direct full‑lifecycle development, integration, deployment, and sustainment of mission software systems spanning analytics, cyber, geospatial, and enterprise data workflows.
Mission‑Critical Delivery: Oversee development and sustainment of classified systems of systems supporting warfighter intelligence, operational planning, and strategic decision‑making using Agile Execution methodologies and strategies to implement and enforce enterprise Agile practices, Program Increment Planning, CI/CD pipelines, and rapid prototyping methodologies across distributed teams.
Customer Engagement & Strategy: Serve as the autonomous senior interface to government sponsors, shaping technical direction, resolving issues, and driving mission‑aligned growth.
Program Leadership: Develop and execute program with disciplined accountability of technical, schedule, and financial matters to maintain performance baselines and embolden customer confidence.
Innovation & Prototyping: Drive rapid prototyping, IR&D initiatives, and technical fellowship‑level solutioning to accelerate mission capability insertion and expand program growth opportunities.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree and 15+ years of experience in software‑intensive program leadership; or Master’s degree with 12+ years; or equivalent experience.
Active TS/SCI with ability to obtain a polygraph once hired.
Demonstrated leadership of large, geographically distributed engineering organizations delivering mission software across classified and unclassified environments. Distribution must be at least two or more physically/geographically separated locations.
Proven success managing $20M+/year software development and sustainment portfolios.
Deep experience with full‑stack software development, DevOps, CI/CD, cloud, cyber, and enterprise data systems.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills spanning technical, operational, and executive audiences.
Experience supporting business development, technical solutioning, and major proposal efforts with hands on knowledge/development of BOEs, RFP/RFI response generation.

Preferred Qualifications

Active TS/SCI with polygraph.
Experience delivering mission‑critical classified systems for the Department of Defense and Intelligence Community.
Background in software architecture, cyber innovation, AI/ML integration, modeling/simulation, or enterprise modernization.
Experience leading multi‑discipline teams of 100+ personnel across diverse technical domains.
Demonstrated ability to recover troubled programs, re‑establish technical execution, and deliver under high‑visibility conditions.
Experience driving IR&D, rapid prototyping, and technical innovation pipelines aligned to mission needs.

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Software
new_jobs.description:
Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.

With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future-proof, backwards-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.

Overview

As Software TPM
, you'll own the execution of our software programs across navigation service, mission operations, and flight software -- working closely with our program lead and engineering teams to keep a fast-moving, highly interdependent software organization on track. Beyond running the program, you'll also build the connective tissue -- tooling, automation, and reporting.

We're looking for someone who is software-first -- you think in releases, dependencies, and code -- but who is genuinely comfortable stepping into hardware territory: sitting in on bus/payload reviews, understanding integration and test constraints, and covering for the Satellite TPM when programs need an extra set of hands. If you want real ownership, proximity to the code and the constellation, and a chance to build both the program and the systems that run it, this role is for you!

Responsibilities

Software Schedule Ownership: Own and maintain the software development schedule across Nav Service, Mission Ops, and flight software (GNC, FSW, payload core), tracking progress against milestones, managing critical path, and keeping the program honest -- especially through the transition from Design/Build/Test into on-orbit operations
Cross-Functional Coordination: Serve as the program hub across Nav Service, Mission Ops, and flight software teams -- translating technical progress into shared plans and clear accountability. Partner tightly with the Satellite TPM to keep software and hardware programs in sync at every shared interface (software readiness, bus interfaces, on-orbit test campaigns).
Release & Dependency Management: Support release management and dependency tracking across all software teams, ensuring releases are coordinated, tested, and deployed without surprises to downstream teams or live operations
System Automation & Tooling: Identify manual operational overhead across teams and build the lightweight tooling, bots, and integrations to eliminate it -- connecting platforms like GitHub/GitLab, Wrike/Linear, Teams, and monitoring tools into a single source of operational truth
Risk & Issue Resolution: Surface risks early, maintain the risk register, and work directly with technical leads to resolve blockers before they hit the schedule. Escalate to program leadership with context and a recommended path forward.
Program Reporting: Prepare and deliver regular software program status to leadership, maintaining a clear and accurate picture of schedule health, open risks, delivery predictability, and upcoming decisions -- automating this reporting wherever possible so status is always current, not just current when someone asks
Process Building: Help develop lightweight, effective program management processes suited to a small team moving fast -- minimizing meeting bloat through automation and async workflows, with real input into how TPM operates at Xona
Hardware Fluency & Flex Coverage: Maintain working fluency in bus and payload development -- enough to sit credibly in integration and test reviews, understand how hardware milestones affect your software schedule, and step in on hardware program coordination or backfill the Satellite TPM when the program needs it

Required Qualifications

4–7 years of program or project management experience in complex software development, with meaningful exposure to aerospace, robotics, or another hardware-adjacent technical field
Direct experience program-managing software teams through both active development and live/operational phases -- you understand that priorities, cadence, and risk look different once something is running in production (or in orbit)
Strong systems thinker who can track interdependencies across multiple software workstreams -- and their interfaces with hardware -- without losing the critical path
Comfortable operating in hardware environments -- you don't need to have owned a bus or payload schedule, but you've been close to spacecraft, robotics, or other complex hardware programs that avionics, RF, or integration/test
Proficient enough as a programmer (Python, TypeScript/Node.js, or Go) to build and deploy lightweight internal tools, bots, and automations yourself
Self-directed and comfortable operating with limited oversight
Clear communicator who can work credibly with engineers and summarize status cleanly for leadership

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with GNSS, PNT systems, or mission operations concepts (telemetry, commanding, ground segment software, on-orbit anomaly response)
Experience building bots, custom integrations across developer toolchains (GitHub, Linear/Wrike, Teams, Datadog, AWS/GCP), or internal developer portals
Hands-on experience with satellite bus subsystems or RF/navigation payloads, or having worked through a full satellite program cycle from PDR/CDR through integration, test, and launch/operations
Hands-on knowledge of workflow automation platforms (Temporal, n8n, Airflow, or similar)
Prior experience as a software engineer or DevOps engineer before moving into technical program management
PMP, Agile, or other PM certifications (nice to have, not a substitute for real program experience)

For U.S. Roles:
To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

To comply with U.K. regulations, this role requires Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks, and successful candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC).

Successful candidates must obtain and hold a security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and ITAR.

Description

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

Within the Experience Validation organization, the Field Integration and Testing (FIT) team pioneers end-to-end network field validation—testing Leo's full signal path from the customer terminal through gateway infrastructure to the internet, in real customer environments that labs cannot fully replicate. We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive the execution of FIT's core testing operations and its international expansion as Leo scales across territories and new hardware. You will be the connective tissue between FIT, Leo engineering, the Beta teams, and the Amazon Devices Field Quality Engineering (FQE) partnership, keeping test coverage aligned with a fast-moving release cadence of new customer terminals, firmware, and mobile app builds.

Key job responsibilities

In this role, you will own the program mechanics across FIT's three prioritized workstreams. For core operations, you will coordinate pre-release testing of new hardware and app releases before they reach Beta cohorts, create and drive resolution of bugs and quality issues, and track the health and uptime of the Solution Lab CT fleet as a shared resource for Leo teams. You will coordinate execution of country-specific functional test cases (e.g. regional IP routing, KPOP routing, Legal Interception) and B2B use cases—across Solution Labs in the Americas and EMEA, and support Solution Lab and demo center expansion into future markets. In the process ou will help operationalize the FQE partnership so expert testers can be dispatched to any country on short notice. Throughout, you will manage schedules, dependencies (including Beta Ops provisioning, hardware delivery, and spot enablement), open items, and risks, and maintain clear, data-backed status for leadership.

Success in this role requires strong technical program management judgment, comfort with networking and connectivity concepts, and the ability to coordinate many moving parts across teams, vendors, and geographies. You will define and report the metrics that show testing is on track and you anticipate dependencies and risks before they slip. You will write and communicate crisp and concise updates The ideal candidate is a hands-on, highly organized TPM who thrives in ambiguity, is comfortable working closely with engineers and field testers on production hardware and real integrations, and is energized by the challenge of proving out a brand-new satellite connectivity experience country by country.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life

You start your morning reviewing program dashboards and triaging any overnight issues that need immediate attention. By mid-morning you are leading a cross-team sync, aligning engineers and product partners on upcoming milestones and surfacing risks early. After lunch you might deep-dive into a technical design review, asking the right questions to ensure the proposed solution accounts for upstream and downstream impacts. Later, you draft a status narrative for leadership, distilling complex details into a clear story that drives decisions.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of technical product or program management experience
2+ years of software development experience
3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Working knowledge of networking or connectivity concepts (e.g., IP routing, DNS, DHCP, latency, packet loss, VPN)

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Experience in satellite, telecommunications, wireless/RF, networking, or other connectivity/hardware domains
Experience managing test, integration, verification, or field-testing programs involving physical hardware and third-party equipment
Experience with defect/bug management processes and driving issues to resolution with engineering teams
Experience coordinating lab operations or distributed field testing across multiple countries
Familiarity with regulatory/compliance verification (e.g., lawful interception, RF compliance) or B2B/enterprise connectivity (AWS Direct Connect, enterprise routers)

new_jobs.description:
Company Overview

ID.me is the next-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Consumers can verify their identity with ID.me once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 152 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with ID.me at 20 federal agencies, 45 state government agencies, and 70+ healthcare organizations. More than 600+ consumer brands use ID.me to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. ID.me’s technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800-63-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. ID.me is committed to “No Identity Left Behind” to enable all people to have a secure digital identity. To learn more, visit https://network.id.me/.

ID.me is a full-time, in-office culture. Unless a specific job description explicitly states otherwise, all roles are on-site five days per week at one of our offices in McLean, VA; Mountain View, CA; New York City, NY; or Tampa, FL. Certain roles — such as field-based sales or other remote-by-design positions — may have different work arrangements as noted in their individual postings.

At ID.me, we embrace the thoughtful use of AI tools in our daily work and there are even occasions where we leverage AI in our hiring process. However, during the interview process, we want to understand your individual skills and experiences. Therefore, we have guidelines on how AI can be appropriately used during your application and interviews which can be found here.

ID.me is looking for a senior threat intelligence professional to lead technical tracking of the adversaries targeting the identity verification ecosystem, and to turn that tracking into decisions the business acts on. Identity fraud is an industrialized market of credential and document vendors, injection and deepfake tooling, synthetic identity brokers, and organized account takeover crews. This role sits directly across from it.

You will own intelligence coverage for a defined set of threats end to end: setting the collection strategy, running the research, building the models and tooling, and delivering the finished product to the people who need it, from detection engineers to executives and government partners. This is a senior individual-contributor role with high autonomy and real influence over security and product direction. You will also be a technical mentor to the analysts around you and a standard-setter for how the team does analysis.

Responsibilities

Own an intelligence portfolio. Take end-to-end responsibility for tracking a set of threat actors, fraud typologies, or ecosystems targeting ID.me and our partners, from collection through analysis to delivery and follow-up.
Set collection strategy. Define and prioritize intelligence requirements in partnership with security, fraud, product, and company leadership. Identify gaps in current coverage and close them.
Run technical collection at depth. Conduct sustained collection and source development across deep and dark web forums, illicit marketplaces, encrypted messaging platforms, and closed communities, using sound tradecraft and operational security.
Hunt emerging activity. Proactively hunt for new actor activity, tooling, and TTPs across internal telemetry and external sources, and pull threads before they become incidents.
Produce finished intelligence. Write assessments that hold up to scrutiny, with clear judgments, stated confidence levels, articulated assumptions, and specific recommendations, for audiences ranging from engineers to the executive team to external partners.
Make intelligence operational. Convert research into detections, fraud signals, blocklists, enrichment, and platform data. Work with detection engineering, data science, and product to get it deployed and measure whether it worked.
Advance the team's analytic tradecraft. Improve threat modeling standards, structured analytic methods, reporting templates, source evaluation, and the team's use of frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and the Diamond Model.
Build tooling and automation. Identify where manual work is limiting coverage and build or specify the tooling, pipelines, and enrichment to remove it.
Mentor and raise the bar. Coach analysts on collection tradecraft, analytic writing, and structured analysis. Review their work and help develop their judgment.
Represent the function. Brief senior leadership, partners, and where appropriate, industry peer groups, law enforcement, and information-sharing communities.

Qualifications

5+ years of experience in threat intelligence, cyber threat hunting, fraud intelligence, or a closely related discipline, including experience producing finished intelligence for decision-makers.
3+ years of hands-on collection across the deep and dark web, including illicit marketplaces and encrypted communication platforms, with demonstrated tradecraft and operational security practices.
Deep, applied experience with common analysis models and frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, the Diamond Model, kill chain, structured analytic techniques). Not just familiarity, but a track record of using them to reach and defend analytic judgments.
Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous, fragmentary, and conflicting information and produce a clear assessment with appropriately expressed confidence.
Exceptional written and verbal communication, including experience writing for both deeply technical and executive audiences.
Track record of working independently: scoping your own problems, setting priorities, and driving work to a result without close direction.
Proven ability to influence stakeholders outside of security, and to translate intelligence into changes other teams actually make.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with identity fraud, account takeover, synthetic identity, document and biometric fraud, or the fraud-as-a-service ecosystem.
Strong SQL skills for independent data analysis at scale, and scripting in Python or similar for collection, enrichment, and automation.
Experience turning intelligence into production detections or fraud controls alongside engineering and data science teams.
Experience mentoring analysts or leading intelligence projects across multiple contributors.
Relevant certifications such as GCTI, GREM, GCFA, GOSI, CISSP, or Security+.
Working proficiency in a foreign language relevant to threat actor communities.
Experience in a regulated or government-facing environment, or supporting external partners with intelligence products.

About You

Compiling and analyzing data from multiple internal and external sources to identify trends, monitor performance, and provide actionable business insights.
Executing recurring monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting processes for both internal stakeholders and Fund members.
Monitoring claims, underwriting, financial, operational, and member service performance through established reporting tools and methodologies.
Validating, reconciling, and quality-checking data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability across systems and reporting environments.
Collaborating with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs and translate business questions into meaningful analytical solutions.
Developing and enhancing dashboards, reports, and visualizations that help stakeholders track performance and make informed decisions.
Investigating data issues and partnering with cross-functional teams to resolve data quality, processing, or integration challenges.

If you’re still reading, we’d love to meet you!

How You’ll Make An Impact

In this role, you will play a key part in helping Risk Management Services leverage data as a strategic asset. Your work will directly contribute to improving business outcomes, operational efficiency, and decision-making by:

Applying statistical methods, quantitative analysis, and analytical models to evaluate Fund performance and identify emerging risks and opportunities.
Supporting data-driven decision-making through meaningful reporting, trend analysis, forecasting, and performance measurement.
Partnering with managers and staff across Risk Management Services to deliver analyses that support operational, financial, and strategic objectives.
Recommending performance measures, metrics, and reporting solutions that provide greater visibility into business operations.
Participating in data modernization, reporting enhancement, and business intelligence initiatives that improve organizational effectiveness.
Helping ensure that leaders and business partners have timely, accurate, and actionable information to guide decision-making.
Preparing presentations, executive summaries, and visual reports that clearly communicate findings and recommendations.

Skills Or Requirements For Success

Successful candidates bring strong quantitative abilities, curiosity, and a passion for transforming data into actionable insights, including:

Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Actuarial Science, Economics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
One to two years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, statistical analysis, reporting, or a related discipline.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, data modeling, macro development, complex formulas, and analytical functions.
Experience querying and analyzing data using SQL or a similar data programming language.
Understanding of relational databases, data structures, and normalization principles.
Experience developing dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau, Business Objects, or similar business intelligence tools.
Familiarity with Python, R, VBA, or other programming and statistical analysis languages preferred.
Interest in predictive analytics, statistical modeling, machine learning, or artificial intelligence applications preferred.

Enjoy competitive pay and rich benefit offerings.

Learn and grow individually and together through frequent professional development, wellness seminars, and more.

Construire et faire évoluer les outils de pilotage financier

Concevoir et maintenir des tableaux de bord destinés à la Direction Finances & Risques ;
Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la pertinence des données utilisées ;
Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des outils de suivi et d'aide à la décision.

Analyser les données liées au chiffre d'affaires, à la sinistralité, à la production et au portefeuille ;
Identifier les leviers explicatifs des résultats observés ;
Travailler en proximité avec les équipes métiers afin de proposer des recommandations concrètes et des plans d'actions pertinents.

Un poste à forte visibilité auprès de la Direction Finances & Risques
Des enjeux stratégiques et des analyses au cœur des décisions de l'entreprise
Une équipe experte de la donnée favorisant le partage de connaissances
Un environnement stimulant mêlant finance, assurance et traitement de données
L'opportunité de développer votre expertise dans un groupe reconnu du secteur de l'assurance

Vous vous reconnaissez dans ce profil ?

Vous êtes passionné par l'analyse de données et souhaitez mettre votre expertise au service d'enjeux financiers complexes.

Diplômé d'un Master en statistiques, data science, traitement des données ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation finance, actuariat ou assurance.

Expérience

Vous disposez d'au moins 5 années d'expérience dans le pilotage financier ou technique au sein du secteur de l'assurance.

Vous maîtrisez les problématiques liées à la performance économique et au suivi d'indicateurs financiers.

Compétences techniques

Excellente maîtrise de SAS et SQL ;

Maîtrise d'un outil de Data Visualisation tel que Qlik (ou équivalent) ;

Des connaissances du langage R seraient appréciées.

Qualités personnelles

Forte capacité d'analyse et de synthèse ;

Curiosité intellectuelle et esprit critique ;

Sens du résultat et orientation solution ;

Aisance relationnelle et goût du travail en équipe ;

Capacité à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs métiers et à transformer les données en recommandations opérationnelles.

Environnement de travail

Vous rejoindrez le pôle Technique & Financier du Datalab, en interaction directe avec les équipes Finance & Risques. Vous bénéficierez d'un environnement où la donnée est un levier essentiel de performance et où votre expertise aura un impact concret sur les décisions de l'entreprise.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone with strong data skills and a passion for sustainability to help map regulatory obligations, analyze packaging and sales data, and support reporting that drives compliance and environmental improvement across our business. You will collaborate with internal teams and external consultants to ensure accurate data collection, reporting, and insight generation.

Solstice Advanced Materials is looking for a Data Analyst to
support our Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)
program across the EU and UK / US.

You will collaborate with internal teams and external consultants to ensure accurate data collection, reporting, and insight generation.

This role can be located in Morris Plains, NJ or Geismar, LA.

Key Responsibilities

Map and track EPR obligations across Solstice businesses in the EU and UK / across US States and Canada
Collect, validate, and analyze packaging, sales, and environmental data
Investigate and implement alternative compliant packaging types [ FF1] in partnership with Logistics and Manufacturing organizations
Support regulatory reporting and monthly leadership reporting
Maintain accurate data within EPR management systems and reporting tools
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities to improve data quality and compliance
Work with stakeholders across the business to resolve data issues and improve processes
Support audits, evidence gathering, and continuous improvement activities

Excellent attention to detail and ability to communicate insights clearly

Interest in sustainability, environmental compliance, and circular economy topics

new_jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to become Earth's most customer-centric company and to grow in a safe environment for both our customers and our associates. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, dynamic, and passionate people.

The Dangerous Goods (DG) team is looking for a motivated Senior Program Manager with strong regulatory experience, operational knowledge, logistics experience, and a hands-on passion to dive deep into processes that support Amazon's growth in a safe environment for customers, partners, and associates.

Working across procurement, transportation services, delivery experience, returns and re-commerce, technology, storage, legal, public policy, and other relevant internal teams on a global scale, this Senior Program Manager will ensure the safety of our associates and transportation partners by delivering innovative solutions for the safe and compliant transportation of DG, redefining industry best practices and standards, and safely enabling an ever-changing borderless business model.

This Senior Program Manager will plan and execute DG policies, controls, and processes to ensure the safe and compliant transportation of DG across a global supply chain. Working collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders, consultants, and regulators, this role will drive safety and compliance across customer deliveries and reverse logistics, enable new selection, and expand business and transportation models. This Senior Program Manager will develop accurate, relevant, metric-driven analysis to foster continuous improvement and step-function innovation that enhances our internal and external customer experience.

Candidates must be based in one of the corporate locations listed in the requisition.

Candidates must be able to travel at least 25% of the time.

Key job responsibilities

Drive continuous improvement projects across global teams, ensuring Amazon Network Fulfillment (AFN) leads the industry in transportation safety and compliance.
Manage a portfolio of projects aimed at building a best-in-class Dangerous Goods transportation system.
Convert large and complex projects into manageable pieces to deliver iterative improvements while focusing on longer-term, large-scale deliverables.
Build collaborative relationships with leaders across regions, departments, and business units.
Refine existing program processes to more efficiently track and prioritize issues, enabling the team to scale its work.
Anticipate project bottlenecks, manage escalations, make tradeoffs, and balance business needs versus operational or technical constraints.

A day in the life

This role works to transform how Amazon safely transports dangerous goods across its global supply chain. You'll leverage continuous improvement and metric-driven analysis to advance transportation safety, classification systems, and compliant transshipment processes across Amazon Network Fulfillment (AFN) and its transportation partners. You'll define program strategy with business owners, build relationships across regions and business units, and communicate regularly with senior leadership on project risks, escalations, and tradeoffs as a subject matter expert in dangerous goods transportation.

About The Team

The Dangerous Goods team ensures the safety of our Customers, associates and carrier partners by delivering innovative solutions to ensure dangerous goods compliance, redefining industry best practices and standards, and safely enabling an ever-changing borderless business model.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders

Preferred Qualifications

Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
Master's degree or equivalent
IMDG, 49CFR, ICAO/IATA, or region specific accreditation

new_jobs.title: Senior Production Security Manager, EU/AF, Studios Protective Services
new_jobs.description:
Description

Are you a strategic security leader ready to define and scale production security standards across two continents? Amazon MGM Studios is seeking a Senior Production Security Regional Manager for Europe and Africa who combines deep expertise in physical risk management, risk forecasting, and risk mitigation with the strategic vision to transform how we protect global film and television productions.

This role requires someone who operates with minimal governance, sets vision for strategically important initiatives, and works across multiple organizations to own programs and complex solution strategies that meet executive scrutiny. You will apply deep understanding of physical risk management, risk forecasting, and mitigation methodologies to production security—designing scalable frameworks, engaging internal and external stakeholders, and driving continuous improvement of our security posture across Europe and Africa.

The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in security risk management roles, with expertise that spans multiple complex environments and the ability to translate complex regulatory and industry requirements into actionable production security strategies. You must be able to advise Directors and VPs, serve as a tie-breaker on critical security decisions, and create collaborative solutions with regulators, law enforcement, and industry bodies that elevate our security standards.

The Senior Production Security Regional Manager defines and scales professional security services across Amazon MGM Studios productions throughout Europe and Africa. Working strategically across organizations, you will own end-to-end physical risk management programs, develop comprehensive risk forecasting frameworks, and create innovative methodologies for physical asset protection that satisfy demanding operational and stakeholder requirements.

Your work is strategic in nature. You handle significantly complex problems, decisions, and escalations—designing, testing, and inspecting scalable solutions that align teams and organizations towards simple, coherent approaches. You apply expertise across multiple physical risk domains and types of complex production environments, creating cross-organizational structures and mechanisms that drive efficiency and consistency.

You serve as the subject matter expert on production security for the region, advising senior studio leadership (Directors and VPs) on proactive risk forecasting and mitigation strategies. You reduce complexity by creating collaborative solutions with regional regulators, law enforcement agencies, and industry bodies. Your judgment serves as the tie-breaker on decisions for how to respond to emerging threats, security escalations, and complex risk scenarios affecting production operations.

Key job responsibilities

Own programs and complex solution strategies across organizations that meet executive scrutiny, advising Directors and VPs on physical risk management and mitigation strategies.
Build consensus and secure commitments across Amazon MGM Studios, Amazon Security, legal, and regional production teams to drive unified security approaches.
Influence external industry and regulatory leaders through force-multiplication—shaping entertainment security norms, standards, and best practices across Europe and Africa.

Execution and Expertise

Design, test, and inspect scalable risk management frameworks for production environments, handling significantly complex problems and escalations
Apply deep expertise across multiple physical risk domains (threat assessment, venue and location security, personnel protection, asset security) to create unified production security standards
Develop and implement comprehensive threat assessment and risk forecasting methodologies tailored to production environments across diverse European and African jurisdictions
Define business strategy for regional production security, establishing new operational models and risk mitigation standards that account for varying threat landscapes
Apply deep understanding of context, capabilities, and opportunities to reduce complexity—creating collaborative solutions with regulators, law enforcement, and industry partners
Serve as tie-breaker on critical security decisions affecting production operations, balancing creative enablement with compliance obligations
Drive impact across 2-3 production security domains (physical risk management, threat forecasting, asset and personnel protection) and multiple regions
Synthesize insights across security, business, operational, and stakeholder domains to drive proactive adaptations to the production security program
Align teams and organizations towards simple, coherent approaches to production security—creating and optimizing cross-organizational structures and mechanisms
Transform vendor management by defining new performance standards, governance models, and risk mitigation frameworks that reset industry expectations
Develop comprehensive metrics, reporting systems, and decision-support documentation for production security programs
Create strategic communication frameworks that enable proactive risk management and informed decision-making at the executive level

A day in the life

Every day presents unique strategic challenges when securing Studio productions across Europe and Africa, requiring innovative approaches to adapt risk management frameworks as productions evolve. As a Senior Production Security Regional Manager, you will shape how we anticipate and respond to dynamic changes driven by creative direction, competing business priorities, shifting threat landscapes, and evolving global conditions.

This field-based leadership role requires you to build and influence a complex network of relationships spanning Studios and Production executives, regional security partners, law enforcement agencies, regulatory bodies, and Amazon intelligence teams. You develop comprehensive risk forecasting and mitigation strategies that protect Studios’ people, assets, and brand reputation while satisfying diverse compliance obligations.

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Production Security is an elite global network of security and risk strategists aligned with Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios’ strategic priorities worldwide. Working at the intersection of creative vision and security excellence, our team develops innovative approaches to anticipate and address complex production risks across diverse international environments. We leverage multi-source intelligence and our trusted global partner ecosystem to create proactive security solutions that support filmmakers’ creative ambitions while ensuring the safety of our people, protection of our assets, and preservation of our brand. Through strategic risk assessment, deep industry expertise, and strong partnerships with production teams, law enforcement, and security vendors, we enable creative excellence by providing scalable security frameworks that adapt to the dynamic nature of global production environments.

Basic Qualifications

Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Extensive progressive experience and expertise in security operations, physical risk management, or security program leadership, with demonstrated expertise in designing and executing security programs in complex, multi-jurisdictional environments.
Bachelor’s degree in Security Management, Criminal Justice, International Relations, Emergency Management, or equivalent fields
Demonstrated experience developing and implementing risk management frameworks, risk forecasting methodologies, or threat mitigation programs across multiple countries or regions
Proven ability to advise senior leaders (Director/VP level) and influence organizational strategy on risk management matters
Experience engaging with external partners, law enforcement agencies, or industry bodies on physical risk management and mitigation
Extensive experience leading risk assessment and mitigation programs in dynamic, high-profile environments

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with multiple risk domains (e.g., physical security, threat forecasting, personnel protection, content/asset security) applied across diverse production environments
Proven track record of developing innovative security frameworks that have been adopted across organizations or set industry benchmarks
Experience managing security programs for high-profile entertainment operations or complex business environments
Demonstrated success building and managing networks of external partners including regulators, law enforcement, and industry working groups
History of thought leadership in entertainment security, risk forecasting, physical security strategy

new_jobs.description:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Peraton is hiring a Security Manager.
The qualified candidate will provide security leadership across the contract, including security policy, procedures, planning, evaluation, technology, compliance, incident management, vulnerability management, and GRC. The Security Director coordinates through the Technical Director.

Candidates must be located in the Austin, TX metropolitan area, or San Angelo, TX as applicable or willing to relocate to the Austin, TX metropolitan area.

Key Responsibilities:

Overall accountability for security policy, procedures, planning, evaluation, and technology.
Track, remediate, and report on current and emerging threats and trends to DIR.
Work with the Technical Director and DIR to address current and planned future threats.
Provide compliance oversight for:
TX-RAMP Level 2
TAC 202
CJIS
IRS Publication 1075
MARS-E

Coordinate the annual SOC 2 Type 2 audit.
Manage SOC 2 Type 2 corrective action plans.
Track, report, and remediate security incidents in accordance with TAC Chapter 202.
Develop the annual security plan.
Integrate security activities with GRC processes.
Oversee vulnerability scanning.

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. Lead hypothesis-driven, quantitative projects end-to-end, ensuring cross-team collaboration

new_jobs.description:
Description

POSITION DESCRIPTION:
The 340B Program Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day administration, compliance monitoring, and data audit activities of the organization's 340B Drug Pricing Program. This dual-scope role oversees compliance across both in-house clinical dispensing environments and our external contract pharmacy network, including dedicated channels with WellPartner, Walgreens and Accredo. The Analyst serves as the primary data custodian, utilizing the Intergy EHR platform alongside the third-party administrator (TPA) software to perform regular audits, reconcile inventory, prevent duplicate discounts, and ensure ongoing adherence to Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) guidelines. Adheres to Corporate Compliance program, by reporting improper or unethical conduct, violation of applicable laws, regulations or program requirements.

Detailed Duties And Responsibilities

Data Auditing & Compliance Management

Intergy & WellPartner Audits: Conduct routine audits of 340B claims by cross-referencing patient clinical data from Intergy EHR with encounter records processed via the WellPartner TPA platform.
Contract Pharmacy Oversight: Monitor, review, and validate qualified 340B prescriptions flowing through external contract pharmacy partners, specifically focusing on specialized Walgreens and Accredo data streams.
In-House Dispensing Monitoring: Track internal clinical encounters and inventory to verify accurate identification of 340B-eligible treatments dispensed within in-house clinics.
Compliance Enforcement: Actively identify and flag potential diversion or duplicate discount violations (specifically regarding Medicaid managed care and fee-for-service claims) prior to regular submissions.

Inventory Control & TPA Optimization

Inventory Reconciliation: Reconcile physical inventory and virtual drug replenishment counters across all internal and contract pharmacy accounts.
System Maintenance: Maintain, update, and test clinical data filters, provider files, and location maps within WellPartner and Intergy to minimize script capture exceptions and optimization gaps.
Accumulation Monitoring: Track WAC and 340B accumulation accounts to ensure clean ordering practices and prevent cross-contamination of drug stocks.

Reporting, Audits & Collaboration

Reporting: Compile, structure, and deliver regular performance metrics and compliance scorecards to the 340B Compliance Administrator and C-Suite.
Audit Preparation: Aggregate and package verifiable historical data logs to support internal reviews and formal HRSA or manufacturer compliance audits.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with internal IT, clinical teams, and account contacts at WellPartner, Walgreens, and Accredo to resolve technical data disparities or workflow blocks.

Requirements

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

Good interpersonal skills.
Ability to conduct oneself professionally.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Advanced capabilities in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, data cleaning formulas) to manage large data extracts from multiple vendors.
Hands-on experience navigating the Intergy EHR system or similar electronic health record platforms for auditing clinical eligibility.
Strong attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies and trends.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established deadlines.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial, operational, and compliance information.
Demonstrate a commitment to ongoing professional development and maintaining current knowledge of 340B regulations, industry best practices, and emerging technologies.

Training And Experience

Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Information Technology, Finance, Business, or a closely related field preferred.
Current Pharmacy Technician Certification (CPhT) or equivalent clinical/administrative licensure is highly advantageous.
Minimum of 1–2 years of direct experience analyzing or handling 340B program data, hospital pharmacy purchasing, or healthcare data compliance operations.

About Tillster

Headquartered in the USA, Tillster is the global leader in digital ordering and customer engagement solutions. For over a decade we have developed revolutionary self-service, ordering and payments solutions – for mobile, tablet, online, kiosk, call center, and more – creating personalized interactions based on consumer preferences, language, and currency. Our platform is compatible with 15+ unique POS systems, representing over 90% coverage in multi-unit restaurants. We offer one platform: one scalable, enterprise class solution – to create world-class digital engagement solutions. Our mission and passion are one in the same: Empower restaurants and consumers to engage and transact anywhere, anytime, and from any device - one consumer at a time, one order at a time, billions of times over. In doing so, together we are transforming e-commerce in restaurants and making the till grow for Tillster and our customers.

Are you a passionate data analytics with a knack for data?

Job Duties

Analytics & Insight Delivery

Own the end-to-end delivery of complex analytical initiatives — from framing the business question and scoping the analysis through execution, presentation, and follow-through on stakeholder action. Do not wait to be asked; proactively surface KPI trends, anomalies, opportunities, and risks before stakeholders encounter them.
Support ad-hoc analysis for Tillster customers, executives, and internal stakeholders — going beyond data retrieval to provide interpretive framing and actionable recommendations with a clear point of view.
Operate as a trusted analytics advisor to Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering, Account Management, and Support/Operations. Challenge assumptions in business requests where data tells a different story. Translate complex findings into decision-relevant narratives.
Design and support A/B test experiments with statistically valid methodology — including hypothesis definition, sample sizing, success and guardrail metric selection, and results analysis. Communicate findings clearly to Product and Marketing stakeholders.

Google Analytics & Data Collection

Act as the team's primary Google Analytics subject matter expert. Own GA4 reporting, custom dimensions and metrics design, tracking plan validation, and GA-to-warehouse integration. Advise on tagging strategy for new product features and platform launches in partnership with the Lead MarTech Solutions Architect.
BI Development & Semantic Layer
Design, build, and maintain high-performing Explores and dashboards in Looker for business stakeholders including Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering, Account Management, and Support/Operations — owning deliverables end-to-end with minimal re-work.
Develop LookML for owned domains to a high quality standard — including complex dimensions, measures, derived tables, and Explore configurations. Ensure all LookML is documented, tested, and consistent with organisation-wide semantic layer standards.
Ensure metric definitions in owned domains are canonical, unambiguous, and consistent with the definitions governed by the Analytics Engineering team. Flag and resolve discrepancies between business intent and semantic layer implementation.
Expand self-service analytics capabilities — enabling non-technical users across Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to answer their own questions independently, reducing ad-hoc request volume to the team. Target coverage across ≥2 new business units per half-year.
Proactively maintain the accuracy and consistency of production Explores and dashboards as underlying data warehouse structures change. Identify discrepancies before stakeholders encounter them.

Data Quality & Platform Collaboration

Own the accuracy and freshness of all data products in scope. Proactively identify and investigate data quality issues — with root-cause evidence — and partner with Analytics Engineers and Data Engineers to resolve upstream problems promptly.
Write high-quality, performant SQL — including complex window functions and CTEs — and collaborate with Data Engineers on query optimisation, compute cost efficiency, and derived table design for owned analytical workloads.
Collaborate with Analytics Engineers on LookML architecture and semantic layer design for owned domains — providing analytical requirements that inform model design and validating that data models correctly reflect business logic.
Partner with the Senior BI & AI Analyst on customer analytics definitions for segmentation, LTV, and churn use cases. Consume ML model outputs from the Data Science team and surface them accurately in dashboards and analytical narratives.
Understand the structure of data pipelines feeding owned dashboards sufficiently to diagnose data freshness and quality issues, escalate to the correct team, and communicate resolution timelines to stakeholders.

Standards, Mentorship & Team Development

Own coding standards and analytical best practices for the team — including SQL style guides, LookML conventions, documentation requirements, and PR review processes. Conduct structured code reviews that are substantive, consistent, and designed to build capability in Junior Analysts.
Mentor Junior Data Analysts through paired analysis, direct feedback, and structured review. Track improvement over time. Escalate development needs or blockers to the Manager.
Build and contribute reusable assets to shared team libraries — including SQL query patterns, LookML components, analysis frameworks, and documentation templates — reducing time-to-delivery for the entire team, not just own work.
Contribute to at least one standards update, governance policy, or best-practice guide per year.

AI-Augmented Analytics & Self-Serve Agent Development

Apply LLM and AI tools (Gemini, GPT-4, Cortex Analyst, or equivalent) hands-on to accelerate analytics workflows — including automated insight narration, anomaly detection and explanation, and AI-assisted dashboard annotation. Practical delivered experience required; theoretical familiarity is not sufficient.
Design and build self-serve analytics agents that enable non-technical stakeholders in Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Account Management to query data and surface insights in natural language — without raising tickets or requiring analyst intervention. Own the full lifecycle from prompt design through output validation and iteration.
Configure Cortex Analyst or equivalent AI-assisted BI platforms to extend self-service beyond traditional dashboard interaction — including semantic model templates and YAML definitions that produce accurate, governed responses to unstructured business questions.
Define quality standards for AI-generated analytical outputs — including accuracy validation, hallucination detection, and a review process before AI-generated insights are shared externally or with executives.
Prototype and propose AI tooling that reduces repetitive analytical work for the team. Present prototypes to the Manager with a clear build-vs-buy recommendation and documented lessons learned that contribute to the team's shared AI analytics playbook.

Skills Required With Years Of Experience

Core Technical Skills (5-7 years total experience)

SQL & Data Analysis
- 4-5 years

Advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs, query optimization)
Complex analytical queries and performance tuning

Business Intelligence Tools
- 3-4 years

Looker expert (LookML development, Explores, dashboards)
Data visualization and self-service analytics design

Google Analytics
- 2-3 years

GA4 implementation, configuration, and reporting
Tracking strategy and warehouse integration

Python/Programming
- 1-2 years (preferred)

Data manipulation and automation
Version control (Git) and code review

Statistical & Analytical Skills (3-5 Years)

A/B Testing & Experimentation
- 2-3 years

Experimental design and statistical testing
Hypothesis formulation and results interpretation

Statistical Analysis
- 3-4 years

Descriptive and inferential statistics
Trend analysis and anomaly detection

AI & Emerging Technologies (1-2 years)

AI-Augmented Analytics
- 1-2 years

Hands-on LLM usage (GPT-4, Gemini, Cortex Analyst)
AI agent development and prompt engineering
AI output validation and quality standards

Business & Communication Skills (4-6 Years)

Stakeholder Management
- 4-5 years

Cross-functional collaboration (Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering)
Executive communication and presentation
Trusted advisor relationships

Business Analytics
- 3-4 years

Customer analytics (segmentation, LTV, churn)
KPI development and metric definition
Translating business questions to analytical frameworks

Leadership & Mentorship (2-3 years)

Team Leadership
- 2-3 years

Mentoring junior analysts
Code review and standards enforcement
Building team best practices and documentation

Project Management
- 3-4 years

End-to-end analytical project ownership
Managing multiple concurrent initiatives
Proactive insight delivery

Thriving at Tillster

As a member of Tillster, you will embody our core values:

Put Customers First: Prioritize the needs and satisfaction of our customers in all decisions and actions appropriate to Tillster’s stage of development, resources, and stated goals.
Collaborate: Work together effectively, leveraging diverse perspectives to achieve common goals.
Innovate: Embrace creativity and pursue new ideas to drive progress and improvement.
Operate from Data: Use strong critical thinking skills to make informed decisions based on accurate and relevant data.
Drive Results: Focus on achieving tangible outcomes and delivering high performance.

Be Passionate and Have Fun: Bring enthusiasm to your work and enjoy the journey.

Interview with Data Science Team
